items.title: Fed在提醒市場別押太多？華爾街分析師對升息前景看法分歧
items.title_en: Is the Fed Warning the Market Not to Over‑bet? Wall Street Analysts Split on Rate‑Hike Outlook
paras: 聯準會(Fed)周三(28日)維持利率不變，但華爾街對決策釋出的訊號看法分歧。部分分析師認為，僅兩名官員主張升息，加上聲明強調等待更多資訊，意味市場對後續緊縮的預期可能過高；另一些人則指出，Fed將經濟成長描述由「穩健」上調為「強勁」，搭配持續偏高的通膨，仍支持12月恢復升息。
Fed本次以10票贊成、2票反對，將聯邦基金利率目標區間維持於3.75%至4%。理事庫克與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克主張升息1碼。聲明表示，累積更多資訊將有助判斷適當政策立場，以確保通膨及時回到2%目標。

等待更多數據 是偏鴿訊號還是升息前的暫停

Harris Financial Group管理合夥人Jamie Cox認為，Fed是在提醒市場，投資人預期的升息幅度可能超過央行實際準備採取的行動。他將「依賴數據」解讀為，除非情勢迫使Fed出手，否則官員暫時不想進一步調整政策。
Corpay首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta則認為，這次僅有兩票反對，少於許多人原先預期的三至四票，算是略偏鴿派的意外。不過，Fed同時上調對經濟的評價，應足以讓市場理解，後續仍可能進一步緊縮。
Annex Wealth Management首席經濟策略師Brian Jacobsen表示，理事投下反對票令人略感意外，但更值得注意的是，Fed將經濟成長描述由「穩健」改為「強勁」。他質疑，在部分就業與成長指標已降溫之際，央行為何反而提高評價。
Jacobsen指出，ADP每周就業增幅的移動平均值，在7月至9月會議之間呈上升趨勢，但此後已轉弱；亞特蘭大聯準銀行GDPNow模型顯示的成長熱度也有所下降。
他認為，這或許解釋了聲明為何採取較模糊的政策措辭。9月Fed曾表示升息是「移除部分寬鬆」，暗示利率仍偏低；本次改稱需要更多資訊來判斷，則讓目前政策是否仍過於寬鬆的答案變得不明確。

高盛估12月恢復升息 明年仍有加碼緊縮風險

高盛資產管理固定收益與流動性解決方案全球主管暨投資長Kay Haigh預期，Fed將於12月恢復升息。她指出，9月強勁的消費者物價指數(CPI)再次提醒市場，通膨上行風險仍在，央行可能透過進一步升息，為這些風險預作防範。
Haigh表示，雖然9月利率點陣圖暗示今年只會再升息一次，但若能源價格再度上揚，或後續經濟數據持續強勁，明年仍可能需要額外緊縮。
Natixis美國首席經濟學家Christopher Hodge的看法更為鮮明。他認為，通膨仍是問題，經濟成長維持穩健，失業率也大致穩定，12月升息幾乎已成定局。真正需要解釋的是，既然最終仍須行動，為何現在要延後？
Hodge指出，這次暫停符合紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯與副主席傑佛遜先前釋出的訊號，即目前沒有連續升息的急迫性。他也推測，兩次會議之間的資產價格波動與部分科技股走弱，可能已帶來一定程度的金融緊縮，讓Fed選擇多等一些數據。
他預期，主席華許可能會強調，Fed觀察的是整體趨勢，而非單一數據，但這樣的回答未必足以滿足市場對暫停理由的疑問。

油價衝擊難靠升息化解 官員面臨政策效果爭論

Motley Fool Asset Management首席投資策略師Bill Mann認為，聲明強調需要「更多資訊」，反映Fed內部可能對石油價格究竟造成多少通膨壓力，存在明顯分歧。
Mann表示，貨幣政策無法直接解決地緣政治造成的失衡。他也質疑，在當前決策中，2%通膨目標是否真的是Fed最優先考量，認為官員重申目標的表態成分較高。
這些評論凸顯華爾街的核心分歧：若通膨壓力主要來自能源與供應衝擊，等待更多資訊有其道理；但若物價壓力持續擴散，且經濟足以承受緊縮，延後升息也可能增加日後控制通膨的難度。

利率不動不等於借貸壓力解除

TransUnion全球研究與顧問主管Charlie Wise表示，Fed此次決策反映其持續權衡通膨風險，以及仍具韌性的經濟與就業情勢。即使近期通膨高於預期，官員仍選擇先評估9月升息的影響，並觀察穩定的勞動市場。
對消費者而言，暫停升息意味信用卡借貸成本暫時不會因本次政策決策而進一步提高，但利率風險並未消失。Wise提醒，隨著假期消費旺季到來，若通膨持續、利率長期居高不下，累積較大的信用卡未償餘額仍可能帶來沉重成本。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged on Wednesday (the 28th), but Wall Street was divided over the signal the decision sent. Some analysts said that only two officials favored a hike and the statement’s emphasis on waiting for more data meant the market may be over‑estimating the likelihood of further tightening; others pointed out that the Fed upgraded its view of economic growth from “steady” to “strong” and, together with still‑elevated inflation, still supports a rate increase in December.

The Fed voted 10‑2 to keep the federal‑funds target range at 3.75%‑4.00%. Board member Cook and Cleveland Fed President Harker each voted for a one‑basis‑point hike. The statement said that gathering more information will help determine the appropriate policy stance to ensure inflation returns to the 2% target in a timely manner.

Waiting for more data – a dovish signal or a pause before another hike? Jamie Cox, managing partner at Harris Financial Group, said the Fed is reminding the market that investors may be expecting larger hikes than the central bank is prepared to deliver. He reads “relying on data” as meaning that unless conditions force the Fed’s hand, officials do not want to adjust policy further for now.

Corpay chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said the two dissenting votes were fewer than the three‑to‑four many had expected, a slightly dovish surprise. However, the Fed’s upgraded economic outlook should be enough for the market to understand that further tightening remains possible.

Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management, said the dissenting votes were a mild surprise, but the more noteworthy point was the Fed’s shift in describing growth from “steady” to “strong.” He questioned why the central bank would raise its assessment when some employment and growth indicators have already cooled.

Jacobsen noted that the moving average of weekly ADP job gains rose between the July‑September meetings but has since weakened, and the Atlanta Fed’s GDPNow model also shows a slowdown in growth momentum.

He believes this may explain why the statement used more ambiguous policy language. In September the Fed said a hike would “remove some accommodation,” implying rates were still low; this time it said more information is needed to judge, leaving the question of whether policy is still too accommodative unclear.

Goldman Sachs estimates a December rate hike, with continued tightening risk next year. Kay Haigh, global head of fixed‑income and liquidity solutions at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, expects the Fed to resume hikes in December. She noted that September’s strong CPI again reminded the market that inflation‑upside risks remain, and the central bank may pre‑emptively tighten further to guard against those risks.

Haigh added that although the September rate‑dot plot suggested only one more hike this year, a resurgence in energy prices or persistently strong economic data could require additional tightening next year.

Natixis U.S. chief economist Christopher Hodge was even more blunt. He said inflation remains a problem, growth stays solid and unemployment is roughly stable, making a December hike almost a foregone conclusion. The real question, he argued, is why the Fed is delaying action now if it ultimately has to act.

Hodge pointed out that the pause aligns with signals previously given by New York Fed President Williams and Vice‑Chair Jefferson that there is no urgent need for consecutive hikes. He also speculated that asset‑price volatility and weakness in some tech stocks between the two meetings may have already introduced a degree of financial tightening, giving the Fed room to wait for more data.

He expects Chair Waller may stress that the Fed is looking at the overall trend rather than any single data point, but that answer may not fully satisfy the market’s demand for a clear rationale for the pause.

Motley Fool Asset Management chief investment strategist Bill Mann said the statement’s emphasis on “more information” reflects an internal split at the Fed over how much oil price shocks are feeding inflation.

Mann argued that monetary policy cannot directly solve the imbalances caused by geopolitical events. He also questioned whether the 2% inflation target is truly the Fed’s top priority in the current decision‑making, suggesting that officials are largely restating the target for political reasons.

These comments highlight the core Wall Street divide: if inflation pressure is mainly from energy and supply shocks, waiting for more data makes sense; but if price pressures keep spreading and the economy can absorb tightening, postponing hikes could make future inflation control harder.

Charlie Wise, head of global research and consulting at TransUnion, said the Fed’s decision reflects its ongoing weighing of inflation risks against a still‑resilient economy and labor market. Even though recent inflation has been higher than expected, officials chose to first assess the impact of the September hike and watch a stable labor market.

For consumers, a pause means credit‑card borrowing costs won’t rise immediately because of this policy move, but interest‑rate risk remains. Wise warned that as the holiday‑spending season approaches, persistent inflation and sustained high rates could make large outstanding credit‑card balances very costly.

items.title: Fed 10月、9月聲明比一比：將「等待更多資訊」判斷下次行動、2人主張升息1碼
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)結束為期兩天的政策會議後，於台灣時間周四(29日)凌晨2時公布利率決策，聯邦基金利率目標區間維持在3.75-4.00%，符合市場預期。以下是Fed 10月會議聲明，與上一次9月會議聲明相比的措詞差異：

10月決策聲明全文

聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)以10票對2票批准發布以下聲明：
「9月啟動三年來首度升息時，是12票全數通過。」
委員會決定將聯邦資金利率目標區間維持在3.75%-4.00%，以支持聯準會的雙重使命。委員會延續維持銀行體系充裕準備金的政策。
「9月聲明寫道：委員會決定將聯邦資金利率目標區間調升0.25個百分點至3.75%-4.00%。」
經濟活動正以強勁步調擴張。雖然部分受到地緣政治局勢發展影響，不確定性仍居高不下，但國內支出一直展現韌性。生產力成長強勁，資本投資也相當穩健。就業成長與勞動力保持同步，失業率變化不大。
「9月聲明寫道：經濟活動正以穩健(solid)步調擴張，兩相比較，10月聲明中的強勁(strong)，措辭更正面。」
通膨依然居高不下。隨著掌握更多資訊，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)將能進一步判斷適當的政策立場，以確保通膨及時回落至委員會判定的2%目標。委員會將實現物價穩定。
「9月聲明寫道：....今日的政策行動將有助於委員會更及時回落至委員會判定的2%目標。...」
反對貨幣政策行動的是庫克(Lisa D. Cook)和哈瑪克(Beth M. Hammack)，兩人都偏好在本次會議上把聯邦資金利率目標區間提高0.25個百分點。
「9月聲明中，所有委員一致支持升息0.25個百分點的決議。」

paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) concluded its two‑day policy meeting and, at 2 a.m. Taiwan time on Thursday the 29th, announced its interest‑rate decision, keeping the federal funds rate target range at 3.75‑4.00%, in line with market expectations. Below is the full text of the October meeting statement.
The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) approved the following statement by a vote of 10 to 2:

The Committee decided to keep the federal funds rate target range at 3.75‑4.00% to support the Fed’s dual mandate. The Committee continues its policy of maintaining ample reserves in the banking system.

Economic activity is expanding at a strong pace. Although some uncertainty remains high due to developments in geopolitical situations, domestic spending has remained resilient. Productivity growth is robust, and capital investment is also fairly solid. Employment growth is keeping pace with the labor force, and the unemployment rate has changed little.

Inflation remains elevated. As more information becomes available, the Federal Open Market Committee will be able to further assess the appropriate policy stance to ensure inflation returns in a timely manner to the Committee’s 2% target. The Committee will achieve price stability.
Opposing monetary‑policy action were Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack, both of whom preferred to raise the federal funds rate target range by 0.25 percentage point at this meeting.

items.title: Fed按兵不動、鷹派不退！兩官員投反對票 市場估12月升息機率逾八成
items.title_en: Fed Holds Steady, Hawks Unwavering! Two Officials Cast Dissenting Votes, Market Prices Over 80% Chance of a December Rate Hike
paras: 聯準會(Fed)周三(28日)以10票贊成、2票反對，決議維持聯邦基金利率目標區間於3.75%至4%，在9月升息後暫時按兵不動。理事庫克(Lisa Cook)與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)投下反對票，主張本次應再升息1碼(25個基點)。
Fed重申，通膨仍處高檔，將透過更多資訊判斷適當政策立場，確保通膨及時回到2%目標，並強調「將實現物價穩定」。聲明雖未明確預告12月升息，市場仍高度預期年底前將再度緊縮。根據芝商所FedWatch工具，截稿時市場預估12月升息1碼的機率約85%。
《華爾街日報》記者、有「Fed傳聲筒」之稱的Nick Timiraos指出，此次暫停升息，是為了爭取時間評估能源成本與人工智慧(AI)建設熱潮是否進一步推升廣泛物價壓力，聲明也未明顯挑戰華爾街對12月可能再度升息的預期。9月公布的預測顯示，多數官員當時認為，今年至少還須升息一次，時間落在本次會議或12月9日結束的下次會議。

庫克首度投下反對票 關切AI建設推升通膨

哈瑪克過去曾支持更緊縮的政策，最近一次是在7月投下主張升息的反對票。她認為，及早進行較小幅度的調整，有助避免未來被迫採取幅度更大、可能更具破壞性的升息。
庫克此次則是加入決策委員會逾四年來，首次投下反對票。她近期表示，AI基礎建設熱潮是她對明年前景最關切的議題，因為相關投資已造成通膨壓力，而且可能不會很快消退。不過，另外兩名7月曾與哈瑪克一同支持升息的官員，本次轉而支持維持利率不變，顯示官員對行動時機仍有分歧。
Fed聲明指出，經濟活動強勁擴張，儘管地緣政治等因素使不確定性居高不下，國內支出仍具韌性，生產力成長與資本投資表現強勁。就業成長與勞動力增長同步，失業率變化不大，Fed也將持續維持銀行體系準備金充裕。
美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)漲幅創五個月來最大，主要受到伊朗戰爭推升能源價格影響，但商品與服務價格也呈現廣泛上漲，讓Fed面臨的物價壓力不僅限於能源。

暫停不代表升息結束 通膨預期成政策關鍵

市場對本次決策的預期，近幾周曾大幅轉變。9月升息後，聯邦基金期貨一度反映10月再升息的機率超過70%；但紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯與副主席傑佛森隨後表示，9月行動已爭取到評估經濟的時間，升息預期因而迅速降溫。
Fed主席華許10月16日也曾表示，9月會議後的情勢大致符合預期，被市場解讀為未打算改變按兵不動的預期。
據《華爾街日報》報導，官員大致認為利率可能仍須進一步提高，但背後理由不盡相同。部分官員認為，現有利率不足以抑制借貸與支出；另一些官員則將升息視為風險管理工具，避免多年高於目標的通膨，讓企業與消費者逐漸接受更頻繁的漲價。
美國通膨已連續逾五年高於Fed的2%目標，2026年也可能成為連續第二個未朝目標取得進展的年度。前Fed資深經濟學家、現任耶魯管理學院教授William English認為，Fed可能仍須小幅升息，但未必需要立即行動，關鍵在於長期高通膨是否使民眾與企業對未來物價的預期升高。
另一名前Fed經濟學家、研究機構Underlying Inflation創辦人Riccardo Trezzi則認為，風險管理反而支持本次升息。他估計，Fed偏好的核心通膨指標9月單月漲幅換算成年率可能達4%，批發物價數據也顯示，後續仍有成本壓力待傳導至消費端。

AI投資與能源衝擊交織 升息效果面臨考驗

本輪通膨壓力與傳統景氣過熱有所不同。AI熱潮推升資料中心、晶片與電力投資，且愈來愈仰賴舉債融資；相關股市漲勢也透過財富效果，支撐高所得家庭消費。另一方面，能源價格與關稅提高企業成本，但勞動市場並未出現明顯過熱跡象。
這讓Fed必須評估，升息究竟能對這些無法直接控制的因素發揮多大作用。調高利率不能增加石油供應，也難以直接阻止科技巨頭競相興建資料中心，但仍可能藉由抑制需求，減緩能源成本向其他商品與服務價格擴散。
前達拉斯聯準銀行總裁、現任高盛(GS-US)副董事長卡普蘭指出，供應衝擊若持續夠久，就不再只是短暫衝擊；即使Fed無法消除供應中斷，仍可降低需求，限制柴油等成本上漲的外溢影響。
對家庭而言，此次維持利率不變未必帶來明顯喘息空間。市場仍預期明年可能進一步升息，而房貸利率追隨的長期美債殖利率也已走高，信用卡、汽車貸款與購屋融資成本仍受壓力。
接下來，市場將聚焦周四(29日)公布的第三季國內生產毛額(GDP)初值與9月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)。經濟學家預估，第三季經濟以年率計算成長約3.2%，相關數據將提供判斷12月政策方向的新線索。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday (the 28th) voted 10‑to‑2 to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 3.75%‑4.0%, pausing after the September hike. Board member Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack cast the dissenting votes, arguing for another 25‑basis‑point increase this time.

The Fed reiterated that inflation remains elevated and that it will use more data to gauge the appropriate policy stance, ensuring inflation returns to the 2% target and emphasizing that “price stability will be achieved.” Although the statement did not explicitly forecast a December hike, markets still heavily expect another tightening before year‑end. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, at the close of the article the market estimated about an 85% probability of a 25‑basis‑point hike in December.

Wall Street Journal reporter Nick Timiraos, often called the Fed’s “mouthpiece,” noted that the pause was intended to buy time to assess whether rising energy costs and the AI construction boom are further feeding broad‑based price pressures, and the statement did not markedly challenge Wall Street’s expectation of a possible December hike. September forecasts showed most officials then believed at least one more hike was needed this year, either at this meeting or at the next meeting ending on Dec. 9.

Cook’s first dissenting vote was driven by concerns that AI‑related spending could stoke inflation. Hammack, who previously supported tighter policy – most recently casting a dissenting vote for a hike in July – said that making a modest adjustment early helps avoid having to take larger, potentially more disruptive hikes later.

Cook, who has been on the policy committee for just over four years, voted against the rate‑hold for the first time. She recently said the AI infrastructure boom is her biggest worry for the coming year because the related investment is already adding inflationary pressure and may not dissipate quickly. The other two officials who had backed a hike with Hammack in July switched to supporting a steady rate this time, showing continued disagreement over timing.

The Fed’s statement highlighted that economic activity is expanding robustly, and despite high geopolitical uncertainty, domestic spending remains resilient, productivity growth and capital investment are strong, employment and labor‑force growth are in sync, the unemployment rate is relatively unchanged, and the Fed will keep bank‑system reserves ample.

U.S. consumer‑price inflation in September posted its biggest rise in five months, driven mainly by higher energy prices amid the Iran war, but goods and services prices also rose broadly, meaning the Fed’s price pressures extend beyond energy.

A pause does not mean the end of hikes; inflation expectations are now a key policy lever. Market expectations for the decision shifted dramatically in recent weeks. After the September hike, fed‑funds futures at one point implied over a 70% chance of another hike in October, but New York Fed President Williams and Vice‑Chair Jefferson later said the September action bought time to assess the economy, quickly cooling rate‑hike expectations.
Fed Chair Waller also said on Oct. 16 that the post‑September situation was broadly as expected, which markets read as a signal that the “hold” stance would remain unchanged.

According to the Wall Street Journal, officials generally agree rates may still need to rise further, but for different reasons. Some say current rates are insufficient to curb borrowing and spending; others view hikes as a risk‑management tool to prevent years of inflation above target and to get firms and consumers accustomed to more frequent price increases.

U.S. inflation has run above the Fed’s 2% goal for more than five consecutive years and could become the second straight year in 2026 without progress toward the target. Former Fed economist and current Yale School of Management professor William English believes the Fed may still need a modest hike, though not necessarily immediately, with the key question being whether persistently high inflation is raising long‑term price expectations among households and businesses.

Another former Fed economist and founder of the research firm Underlying Inflation, Riccardo Trezzi, argues that risk management actually supports a hike this time. He estimates the Fed‑preferred core inflation metric’s September monthly gain, annualized, could be as high as 4%, and wholesale‑price data also show lingering cost pressures that could filter through to consumer prices.

AI investment and energy shocks are intertwining, putting the effectiveness of rate hikes to the test. This round of inflation pressure differs from traditional overheating. The AI boom is driving spending on data centers, chips and electricity, increasingly financed by debt; related equity gains are also creating a wealth effect that supports high‑income household consumption. At the same time, higher energy prices and tariffs are raising corporate costs, but the labor market shows no clear signs of overheating.

That forces the Fed to assess how much rate hikes can influence factors it cannot directly control. Raising rates won’t increase oil supply nor directly stop tech giants from building data centers, but it may dampen demand enough to slow the transmission of energy‑cost spikes into other goods and services.

Former Dallas Fed president and current Goldman Sachs vice‑chairman Kaplan noted that if supply‑side shocks persist long enough they become more than a temporary blip; even if the Fed cannot eliminate supply disruptions, it can still curb demand and limit the spillover of cost rises in diesel and other inputs.

For households, the steady‑rate decision may not provide much breathing room. Markets still expect another hike next year, and long‑term Treasury yields that drive mortgage rates have already risen, keeping credit‑card, auto‑loan and home‑loan costs under pressure.

Going forward, markets will focus on Thursday’s (the 29th) release of the third‑quarter GDP advance estimate and September personal‑consumption‑expenditures (PCE) price index. Economists project Q3 growth at about a 3.2% annualized rate, and the data will offer new clues for judging the policy direction in December.

items.title: 果粉準備好了？首款觸控MacBook Pro台灣周五開放預訂 售價近10萬元起
items.title_en: Are Fans Ready? First Touchscreen MacBook Pro Opens Pre‑orders in Taiwan Friday, Prices Near NT$100,000
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周三(28日)發表首款觸控螢幕MacBook Pro，打破近20年來反對觸控筆電的立場。新機首度將OLED面板與動態島導入Mac，搭載針對觸控重新設計的操作介面，提供M5 Pro與M5 Max晶片選項，機身也更薄、更輕，成為執行長特納斯上任後又一項重大產品變革。
根據蘋果台灣官網，搭載ProLED XDR顯示器的新款MacBook Pro，售價新台幣97,900元起，將於周五(30日)上午9時開放預訂，11月6日正式開賣。

觸控 OLED與動態島首度齊聚Mac

新款MacBook Pro提供14吋與16吋兩種尺寸，美國起售價分別為2,899美元與3,399美元，均較既有機型明顯提高。除了首次搭載OLED觸控螢幕，也將iPhone使用者熟悉的動態島帶到Mac。
特納斯在洛杉磯向媒體與分析師表示：「沒錯，我們首次將觸控帶到Mac。」新機仍執行macOS，展示影片中可見使用者直接滑動螢幕操作影片與影像，機身上蓋也配備發光蘋果標誌。蘋果表示，新螢幕提供更高亮度、更佳色彩與更寬廣的可視角度。
蘋果過去長期抗拒觸控筆電。共同創辦人賈伯斯曾批評這類設計在人體工學上「糟透了」，庫克也曾將筆電與平板結合，比喻為把冰箱和烤麵包機合而為一。特納斯2021年仍主張，iPad與Mac分別針對觸控及間接輸入最佳化，沒有改變的理由。
不過，據《彭博》報導，庫克與特納斯約四年前開始支持MacBook Pro採用觸控螢幕，希望透過高階功能與更高售價，為Mac帶來新動能並增加營收。
這也是特納斯上任後第三次重大產品發布。本周蘋果已推出搭載M6的入門款MacBook Pro與iMac，以及改用OLED螢幕的iPad mini；摺疊iPhone「Duo」則於上周五開賣，延續密集新品攻勢。

筆電市場低迷 蘋果押注操作體驗與裝置端AI

新品問世之際，筆電市場正遭遇嚴峻低潮，全年出貨量預估下滑11%。分析師指出，AI需求引發全球記憶體供應吃緊，推高筆電價格，也壓抑消費意願。
IDC估計，第三季全球個人電腦出貨量年減20%，蘋果也下滑11%。蘋果同樣難逃記憶體漲價壓力，今年幾乎所有Mac產品都已調漲售價，8月推出的Mac mini就加價300美元。
儘管如此，Mac的策略地位持續提高。最近一季Mac營收為103.5億美元，占公司總營收不到一成，但仍深受軟體開發者青睞，也是開發iPhone應用程式唯一受支援的平台。
蘋果近月更強調自研晶片與記憶體架構適合執行裝置端AI。本月也與Meta(META-US)共同宣布，透過高速線材串接多台Mac，可執行接近頂尖水準的大型AI模型，為開發者提供雲端服務之外的選擇。
不過，觸控能否帶動換機仍待觀察。IDC副總裁Ryan Reith指出，今年全球筆電出貨中，觸控機型僅占17%，通常不是購機主因。對蘋果而言，關鍵在於介面與軟體體驗，而觸控可能成為吸引開發者的另一項功能。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL‑US) announced its first touchscreen MacBook Pro on Wednesday (28th), breaking its nearly 20‑year stance against touch laptops. The new device introduces OLED panels and a dynamic island to the Mac for the first time, featuring a touch‑optimized interface and options for M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, while the chassis is thinner and lighter, marking another major product shift under CEO Ternus.

According to Apple’s Taiwan website, the new MacBook Pro with a ProLED XDR display starts at NT$97,900 and will open pre‑orders at 9:00 a.m. on Friday (30th), with official sales beginning on November 6th.

The new MacBook Pro comes in 14‑inch and 16‑inch sizes, with U.S. launch prices of $2,899 and $3,399 respectively, both noticeably higher than existing models. In addition to the first OLED touchscreen, it brings the dynamic island familiar to iPhone users to the Mac.

Ternus told reporters and analysts in Los Angeles, “Yes, we’re bringing touch to the Mac for the first time.” The device still runs macOS, and the video shows users sliding the screen to control video and images, with a glowing Apple logo on the lid. Apple says the new screen offers higher brightness, better color, and a wider viewing angle.

Apple has long resisted touch laptops. Co‑founder Jobs once criticized such designs as “horribly ergonomic,” and Cook likened a laptop‑tablet hybrid to a fridge‑toaster combo. Ternus in 2021 still argued that iPad and Mac should remain optimized for touch and indirect input respectively, with no reason to change.

Bloomberg reports that Cook and Ternus began supporting a touchscreen MacBook Pro about four years ago, hoping to bring new momentum and revenue to the Mac line through high‑end features and higher prices.

This is Ternus’s third major product launch since taking office. This week Apple released an entry‑level MacBook Pro and iMac with M6, an iPad mini with OLED, and the foldable iPhone “Duo” went on sale last Friday, continuing a dense new‑product push.

At the time of the launch, the laptop market is in a severe downturn, with annual shipments expected to decline 11%. Analysts note that AI demand has tightened global memory supply, driving up laptop prices and dampening consumer willingness to buy.

IDC estimates that global PC shipments fell 20% YoY in Q3, with Apple down 11%. Apple also faces memory price pressure, raising prices on almost all Mac products this year, including a $300 increase for the Mac mini launched in August.

Despite this, Mac’s strategic position continues to rise. In the last quarter, Mac revenue was $10.35 billion, less than 10% of total company revenue, yet it remains highly favored by software developers and is the only platform that supports iPhone app development.

Apple has recently emphasized that its in‑house chips and memory architecture are well suited for on‑device AI. This month it announced with Meta (META‑US) that connecting multiple Macs via high‑speed cables can run near‑state‑of‑the‑art large AI models, offering developers an alternative to cloud services.

However, whether touch will drive upgrades remains to be seen. IDC VP Ryan Reith noted that touch laptops account for only 17% of global shipments this year, usually not the main purchase driver. For Apple, the key lies in interface and software experience, and touch could become another feature that attracts developers.

items.title: 油、糧、金屬都在漲！世銀估今年大宗商品價格飆23%
items.title_en: Oil, Grain, and Metals All Rising! World Bank Forecasts 23% Surge in Commodity Prices This Year
paras: 世界銀行周三(28日)發布最新《大宗商品市場展望》，預估2026年全球大宗商品價格將上漲23%，主因中東戰爭推升能源成本、干擾貨運，加上黑海穀物運輸受阻，以及黃金等避險資產需求攀升。世銀警告，多重衝擊同時發生，恐加劇通膨、糧食不安全與經濟成長壓力。
世銀預期，明年大宗商品價格將回落7%，但供應衝擊仍可能讓糧價居高不下，尤其氣象預測顯示，聖嬰現象可能為1950年以來最嚴重，增加通膨持續與貨幣政策進一步緊縮的風險。

能源價格估漲32% 石油供應降幅罕見

世銀指出，中東戰爭已消耗全球石油庫存，使全球經濟更難承受後續供應衝擊。今年全球石油供應預估減少5.2%，若排除2020年全球衰退時期，將是40年來最大降幅。
全球能源價格今年預估上漲32%，升至2022年俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭以來最高。隨著石油產量下降，布蘭特原油短期料維持高檔，全年均價預估為每桶92美元。
需求轉弱則部分抑制油價。世銀預估，今年石油需求將減少2.5%，降幅僅次於2020年疫情衝擊與1980年石油危機；若非需求下滑，油價可能更高。
世銀副首席經濟學家Ayhan Kose表示，能源成本上升與貿易受阻正推高多項商品價格。若中東衝突升級、俄羅斯石油基礎設施持續受損，情勢可能進一步惡化。
世銀表示，已向25個受中東戰爭衝擊的國家提供87億美元低成本貸款及其他援助，協助保護弱勢人口，並支持原已背負沉重債務的低收入國家。

糧價兩年恐漲近18% 金屬價格挑戰新高

糧食方面，俄烏在黑海的敵對行動干擾穀物運輸，預估今年食品大宗商品價格將上漲逾10%，明年再漲逾7%，兩年累計漲幅接近18%。
世銀警告，若創紀錄的聖嬰現象、黑海運輸進一步受阻、中東戰事升級及俄國石油設施持續受損同時發生，糧價可能比基準預測再高12%，引發類似2010年代初期的糧食危機。當時危機曾使額外逾4,000萬人陷入極端貧窮。
肥料價格今年則預估因尿素大漲而上升14%，明年才回到2025年水準，對農業生產成本形成壓力。
金屬價格今年預估上漲25%、創歷史新高，其中鋁、銅與錫受供應中斷，以及再生能源、電動車與資料中心投資需求支撐，價格均料刷新紀錄。貴金屬價格則預估上漲40%，反映地緣政治與政策不確定性帶動避險需求，明年漲勢可望有所緩和。
paras_en: The World Bank on Wednesday (the 28th) released its latest "Commodity Market Outlook," projecting that global commodity prices will rise 23% in 2026. The main drivers are higher energy costs and disrupted shipping due to the Middle‑East war, blocked grain shipments through the Black Sea, and soaring demand for safe‑haven assets such as gold. The Bank warns that multiple shocks occurring together could worsen inflation, food insecurity and pressure on economic growth.

The Bank expects commodity prices to fall 7% next year, but supply shocks could keep food prices elevated, especially as weather forecasts indicate that the upcoming El Niño may be the strongest since 1950, raising the risk of persistent inflation and further monetary tightening.

Energy prices are projected to jump 32% as oil supply falls sharply. The Bank notes that the Middle‑East war has depleted global oil inventories, making the world economy more vulnerable to subsequent supply shocks. Global oil supply is estimated to decline 5.2% this year – the biggest drop in 40 years if the 2020 recession period is excluded.

Global energy prices are expected to rise 32% this year, reaching the highest level since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in 2022. With oil output falling, Brent crude is forecast to stay at the high end in the short term, with an average price of $92 per barrel for the year.

Weaker demand partially offsets the price rise. The Bank projects oil demand to fall 2.5% this year, the second‑largest decline after the 2020 pandemic shock and the 1980 oil crisis; without the demand drop, prices would have been even higher.

World Bank Deputy Chief Economist Ayhan Kose said that rising energy costs and trade disruptions are pushing up many commodity prices. If the Middle‑East conflict escalates further and Russian oil infrastructure remains damaged, the situation could deteriorate further.

The Bank says it has provided $8.7 billion in low‑cost loans and other assistance to 25 countries affected by the Middle‑East war, helping protect vulnerable populations and supporting low‑income nations already burdened with heavy debt.

Food prices could rise almost 18% over two years. Hostilities between Russia and Ukraine in the Black Sea are disrupting grain shipments, and the Bank estimates that food commodity prices will increase by more than 10% this year and by another 7% next year, totaling a near‑18% gain over two years.

The Bank warns that if a record‑breaking El Niño, further Black Sea transport disruptions, an escalation of the Middle‑East war and continued damage to Russian oil facilities all occur together, food prices could be 12% higher than the baseline forecast, sparking a crisis similar to the early 2010s that pushed over 40 million people into extreme poverty.
Fertilizer prices are projected to rise 14% this year due to a surge in urea costs, only returning to 2025 levels next year, adding pressure on agricultural production costs.

Metal prices are expected to climb 25% this year, hitting historic highs. Aluminum, copper and tin are supported by supply interruptions and demand from renewable energy, electric vehicles and data centers, with all likely to set new records. Precious metals are forecast to rise 40%, reflecting geopolitical and policy uncertainty driving safe‑haven demand, though the upward trend should ease next year.

items.title: 才發表新品就裁員！亞馬遜裝置部門裁員約250人
items.title_en: Just Launched New Products, Then Layoffs! Amazon's Devices Division Cuts About 250 Jobs
paras: 亞馬遜(AMZN-US)新品密集登場之際，也同步調整人力。《路透》報導，亞馬遜周三(28日)在裝置與服務部門裁員約250人，主要涉及軟體開發人員。同日，公司才宣布推出搭載Alexa的智慧鬧鐘與數位相框。
亞馬遜在《路透》詢問後證實裁員。公司發言人表示：「我們做出了裁減少量職位的艱難決定。」但未進一步說明細節。據知情人士透露，此次受影響職位不超過250個。
發言人表示，這項調整將協助公司「更有效率地營運，並更符合產品發展規畫」。過去幾周，亞馬遜接連推出新款Kindle電子書閱讀器、平板電腦等產品，如今一邊擴充裝置陣容，一邊縮減相關部門人力。
依照公司慣例，受影響員工於周三清晨收到簡訊與電子郵件通知。《路透》看到的一封郵件，由裝置與服務部門人力資源副總裁Cherie Robinson發出，內容指出，公司已對組織架構進行「全面檢視」，並因此決定裁減職位。
這並非亞馬遜本月首波人力調整。公司本月稍早已在核心零售部門裁減約1,000個職位，最新裁員則延伸至裝置與服務業務。亞馬遜預計於周四(29日)美股盤後公布第三季財報。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) is rolling out a wave of new products while simultaneously adjusting its workforce. Reuters reported that on Wednesday (the 28th) Amazon laid off roughly 250 employees in its Devices and Services division, primarily software developers. The same day, the company announced the launch of an Alexa‑enabled smart alarm clock and a digital photo frame.

Amazon confirmed the layoffs after Reuters’ inquiry. A company spokesperson said, “We have made the difficult decision to reduce a small number of positions,” but did not provide further details. Insiders said the number of affected roles does not exceed 250.

The spokesperson added that the adjustment will help the company “operate more efficiently and align better with product development plans.” In recent weeks Amazon has introduced new Kindle e‑readers, tablets and other devices, expanding its hardware lineup while trimming staff in the related division.

As per company practice, the affected employees received text messages and emails early Wednesday morning. Reuters saw one such email, sent by Cherie Robinson, vice‑president of human resources for Devices and Services, which stated that the organization had undergone a “comprehensive review” and consequently decided to cut positions.

This is not Amazon’s first workforce adjustment this month. Earlier in the month the company cut about 1,000 jobs in its core retail segment, and the latest layoffs extend to the Devices and Services business. Amazon expects to release its third‑quarter earnings after the U.S. market close on Thursday (the 29th).

items.title: 燃油成本飆344%！環遊世界豪華郵輪突停航、200名乘客受困柬埔寨
items.title_en: Fuel Costs Surge 344% — Luxury World‑Cruise Halts, About 200 Passengers Stranded in Cambodia
paras: 一艘以「永久海上生活」為賣點、主打為期多年環球航程的豪華郵輪，卻因燃油成本異常高漲而宣布暫停營運，約200名乘客因此受困柬埔寨。
負責經營的美國郵輪營運商Villa Vie Odyssey周二(27日)宣布，由於燃油成本大幅攀升，已暫停在柬埔寨的營運，正與乘客協調下船計畫及「臨時住宿安排」。
在宣布暫停航程前，環球航行已進行超過750天，代表船上乘客如今將受困柬埔寨。彭博引述郵輪營運商創辦人的說法報導，當時船上約有200名乘客，接獲通知須在柬埔寨下船。
今年稍早伊朗戰爭爆發後，全球燃油價格大幅飆升。該公司表示，亞洲部分地區每間客艙每月的燃油成本，已從1,800美元上升到6,000至8,000美元，最多暴增344%。
在美以對伊朗戰爭2月爆發後，伊朗隨後關閉全球石油運輸的重要咽喉要道荷姆茲海峽，推升全球能源價格。
Villa Vie Residences說：「自2月底衝突爆發以來，我們已採取多項重大措施降低燃油消耗，包括放慢航程安排，以及延長停靠港口的時間。但這些措施仍不足以抵銷燃油成本異常上漲帶來的衝擊，我們已無法繼續承擔因此產生的營運虧損。」
Villa Vie Residences在這艘擁有509間客艙的奧德賽號(Odyssey)上出售永久居住權，價格介於11萬9,999美元至43萬9,999美元。該公司向住客推銷的是一趟永無止境的環球郵輪之旅，沿途造訪150個國家、停靠400多個港口，每三年半完成一次環球航行。
奧德賽號於2024年9月從貝爾法斯特首度啟航，但先前已因延誤而推遲了四個月。
這艘郵輪設有泳池甲板、水療設施及匹克球場，也提供為期五年的居住權，價格從5萬9,999美元起。
Villa Vie Residences表示，燃油成本上升已對公司的營運模式造成難以持續的財務壓力，並補充指出，目前正在評估各種選項，但尚未敲定任何融資或交易。
該公司表示：「將全部成本增幅轉嫁給住客，並不是切實可行的解決方案。我們目前的重點，是在未來60天推動重組與資本整頓的同時，協助住客、船員及員工。相關工作仍在進行中，但無法保證最終結果。」
目前不清楚船上究竟有多少人，Villa Vie Residences也未透露此次受影響的住客人數。這艘船長近200公尺，最多可搭載650名乘客。
paras_en: A luxury cruise ship marketed as a “permanent life at sea” and promising multi‑year global voyages has announced a suspension of operations due to abnormally high fuel costs, leaving roughly 200 passengers stranded in Cambodia.

The U.S. cruise operator Villa Vie Odyssey announced on Tuesday, the 27th, that it has halted operations in Cambodia because of the sharp rise in fuel expenses and is coordinating disembarkation plans and “temporary accommodation arrangements” with passengers.

Before the suspension was announced, the world‑circling voyage had already lasted more than 750 days, meaning the passengers on board are now stuck in Cambodia. Bloomberg, citing the cruise operator’s founder, reported that about 200 passengers were on the ship when they were told they had to disembark in Cambodia.

Earlier this year, after the outbreak of the Iran‑Israel war, global fuel prices surged dramatically. The company said that in parts of Asia the monthly fuel cost per cabin has jumped from $1,800 to $6,000‑$8,000, a rise of up to 344%.
Following the February outbreak of the US‑Israel war with Iran, Iran subsequently closed the strategic Hormuz Strait, a key global oil‑transport chokepoint, pushing up worldwide energy prices.

Villa Vie Residences said: “Since the conflict erupted at the end of February, we have taken a number of major steps to reduce fuel consumption, including slowing our sailing schedule and extending port stays. Yet these measures are insufficient to offset the extraordinary rise in fuel costs, and we can no longer absorb the resulting operating losses.”

Villa Vie Residences sells permanent residency rights on the Odyssey, a ship with 509 cabins, at prices ranging from $119,999 to $439,999. The company markets an endless global cruise that visits 150 countries, calls at more than 400 ports, and completes a circumnavigation every three and a half years.
The Odyssey launched its maiden voyage from Belfast in September 2024, after having been delayed four months previously.
The vessel features a pool deck, spa facilities and a pickleball court, and offers five‑year residency rights starting at $59,999.

Villa Vie Residences said the surge in fuel costs has created unsustainable financial pressure on its business model, adding that it is evaluating various options but has not yet finalized any financing or transaction.

The company stated: “Passing the full cost increase onto residents is not a viable solution. Our current focus is to drive restructuring and capital re‑organization over the next 60 days while supporting residents, crew and staff. The work is ongoing, but we cannot guarantee the final outcome.”

It remains unclear exactly how many people are on board; Villa Vie Residences has not disclosed the number of affected residents. The ship is nearly 200 metres long and can accommodate up to 650 passengers.

items.title: 巴基斯坦髮夾彎！彭博：改口允許台灣航空公司飛越領空
items.title_en: Pakistan Reverses Course! Bloomberg: Allows Taiwanese Airlines to Fly Over Airspace
paras: 知情人士透露，巴基斯坦已恢復台灣航空公司飛越領空權，先前巴基斯坦為支持「一個中國」政策，禁止台灣航空公司飛越領空。
《彭博》取得的日期標注為10月28日的文件顯示，巴基斯坦民航局已批准中華航空和長榮航空於10月28日至隔年3月27日期間使用這個南亞國家的領空。
巴基斯坦國防部長Khawaja Asif 28日稍早接受《彭博》採訪時表示：「航空管理部門奉行『一個中國』政策——只向中國大陸開放，我方只允許中國（大陸）航空公司飛越領空。」
台灣航空公司自上周末開始調整航線。航班追蹤網站Flightradar24的數據顯示，自10月25日上午以來，中華航空和長榮航空的航班均未再飛越巴基斯坦領空。這兩家航空公司至少有12班往返亞洲和歐洲的航班改飛俄羅斯領空。
自2022年2月以來，台灣航空公司與大多數亞洲、歐洲和北美航空公司一樣，一直避免飛越俄羅斯領空。
北京長期以來一直企圖在國際舞台上孤立台灣，但過去從未有任何國家聲明要禁止所有台灣航空公司飛越領空。
新加坡國立大學政治學副教授莊嘉穎（Ian Chong）表示，北京一直要求更多國家對台灣施壓，而巴基斯坦是北京最親密的夥伴之一。
我外交部28日晚間表示，中華民國台灣是主權獨立的國家，與中華人民共和國從不隸屬，這是無法否認的客觀事實與台海現狀。任何意圖透過言論或共同聲明抹黑台灣主權地位的論述，皆無法改變此一不爭事實。
外交部說，將持續與主管機關交通部保持密切聯繫，並尊重台灣民航業者基於飛航安全、飛行時間及成本等考量，進行最佳效益路線之規畫。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Sources say Pakistan has reinstated the right for Taiwanese airlines to fly over its airspace, after previously banning them in support of the "One China" policy.
A Bloomberg‑dated document from October 28 shows the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority approved EVA Air and China Airlines to use the country's airspace from October 28 to March 27 next year.

Pakistan Defence Minister Khawaja Asif told Bloomberg earlier on the 28th that the aviation authority follows the "One China" policy—open only to mainland China, and only mainland carriers may fly over.

Taiwanese airlines began adjusting routes last weekend. FlightRadar24 data shows that since the morning of October 25, neither EVA Air nor China Airlines have flown over Pakistan; at least 12 of their Asia‑Europe flights have rerouted through Russian airspace.
Since February 2022, Taiwanese airlines, like most Asian, European and North American carriers, have avoided Russian airspace.
Beijing has long sought to isolate Taiwan internationally, but no country has ever declared a blanket ban on all Taiwanese airlines flying over its airspace.
Ian Chong, associate professor of political science at NUS, said Beijing has demanded more pressure on Taiwan, and Pakistan is one of Beijing's closest partners.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs said on the evening of the 28th that Taiwan is a sovereign independent state, never subordinate to the People's Republic of China, an undeniable fact and the status quo across the Taiwan Strait. Any attempt to smear Taiwan's sovereignty through statements or joint declarations cannot change this indisputable fact.

The ministry will continue to liaise closely with the Ministry of Transportation and Communications, respecting Taiwanese civil aviation operators' planning of optimal routes based on safety, flight time and cost considerations.
(This article is not open for partner reposting)

items.title: 穩懋光學、基建營收Q3營收占比已過半 看好2027年低軌衛星及航太產品發展
items.title_en: Winstar Optical and Infrastructure Revenue Share Exceeds Half in Q3, Positive Outlook for 2027 Low‑Earth‑Orbit Satellite and Aerospace Products
paras: 三五族砷化鎵PA廠穩懋(3105-TW)今(28)日下午舉辦法說會，穩懋表示，隨著第三代衛星規格(V3)開始啟動，加上衛星直接連接手機等實際應用持續發展，目前穩懋在低軌衛星、航太及點對點傳輸通訊上等基礎建設營收已超過40%，其中光學、基礎建設營收占比第3季已過半。隨著光通訊發展持續強勁，穩懋對2027年相關非手機產品需求維持正向樂觀看法。
穩懋表示，近年來因地緣政治升級，持續推動中國中低階手機Cellular PA在地的供應鏈自製率上升，今年更因記憶體缺貨推升終端售價上漲，導致全球智慧型手機高階與中低階機種出現此消彼漲之情形，穩懋因聚焦在中高階手機市場具有相對性優勢。
此外，穩懋表示，長期布局無線微波通訊及光電半導體的多元技術，且具量產規模及國際IDM廠的合作實績，在AI應用全面落地以及新世代低軌衛星密集升空的契機下，有助公司結構性轉型。
總管理處總經理陳舜平表示，2025年下半年起，陸續啟動專案性資本支出，以打通瓶頸限制或提高單片產出，在技術進程上，穩懋針對AI Data Center推出涵蓋短中長距的全方位光通訊解決方案，包括VCSEL、CW Laser、EML及InP PIC，並朝200mW至400mW高功率雷射推進。
另穩懋亦突破目前市面主流0.25μm與0.15μm的限制，成功推進至0.1μm GaN HEMT先進製程，搶攻新世代衛星通訊商機。
在低軌衛星業務方面，穩懋隨第3代衛星規格(V3)開始導入，加上未來衛星直接連接手機等應用逐步發展，對明年需求維持樂觀看法；在光通訊產品部分，穩懋在光學接收端的PD產品，今年處於量產初期及產能爬坡階段，預期明年將迎來較明顯出貨，大規模放量時間點將落在2028年。
paras_en: Winstar (3105‑TW) held an analyst briefing this afternoon, stating that with the launch of third‑generation satellite specifications (V3) and the continued development of practical applications such as direct satellite‑to‑mobile phone connections, its infrastructure revenue from low‑Earth‑orbit satellites, aerospace and point‑to‑point communications now exceeds 40%, and the share of optical and infrastructure revenue has already passed the half‑way mark in Q3. As optical communications keep growing strongly, Winstar remains optimistic about demand for related non‑mobile‑phone products through 2027.

Winstar noted that recent geopolitical tensions have driven up the domestic supply‑chain self‑manufacturing rate for China’s mid‑ and low‑end cellular PA devices. This year, memory shortages have pushed up terminal prices, causing price increases for both high‑end and mid‑low‑end smartphones worldwide. Because Winstar focuses on the mid‑high‑end phone market, it enjoys a relative advantage.

In addition, Winstar said its long‑term diversification into wireless microwave communications and optoelectronic semiconductors, together with mass‑production capacity and proven collaborations with international IDM foundries, positions the company to benefit from the full rollout of AI applications and the intensive launch of next‑generation low‑Earth‑orbit satellites, supporting a structural transformation.

General Manager of the Corporate Management Office Chen Shun‑ping said that starting in the second half of 2025 the company will launch project‑based capital expenditures to remove bottlenecks and increase wafer output. Technologically, Winstar is rolling out a full‑range optical‑communication solution for AI data centers covering short, medium and long distances, including VCSELs, CW lasers, EMLs and InP PICs, and is advancing high‑power lasers of 200 mW to 400 mW.

Winstar also announced that it has broken through the current market limits of 0.25 µm and 0.15 µm processes, successfully advancing to a 0.1 µm GaN HEMT advanced node, positioning itself to capture new‑generation satellite communications opportunities.

Regarding its low‑Earth‑orbit satellite business, Winstar expects continued demand growth as the third‑generation satellite specifications (V3) are adopted and satellite‑to‑mobile applications develop. For optical‑communication products, its photodiode (PD) line on the optical receiving side is in early mass production and capacity ramp‑up this year, with a noticeably larger shipment volume expected next year and large‑scale volume production projected for 2028.

items.title: 台虹財報出爐 前三季稅後純益6.15億元年增79.93% EPS2.33元
items.title_en: Tai Hong Reports Earnings: First Three Quarters After‑Tax Profit NT$6.15 B Up 79.93% YoY, EPS NT$2.33
paras: 由元太科技(8069-TW)入主的FCCL(軟性銅箔基板廠)台虹(8039-TW)今(28)日公布最新財報，2026年第三季稅後純益2.03億元，季減15.75%，年減10.38%，每股純益0.77元，2026年前三季稅後純益6.15億元，年增79.93%，每股純益為2.33元。
台虹2026年第三季營收24.93億元，毛利率22.77%，季減0.36個百分點，年增4.26個百分點，2026年第三季稅後純益2.03億元，季減15.75%，年減10.38%，每股純益0.77元。
台虹科技2026年前三季營收76.05億元，毛利率22.66%，年增3.54個百分點，稅後純益6.15億元，年增79.93%，每股純益2.33元。
台虹今董事會通過與E Ink元太科技(8069-TW)簽訂合作意向書，台虹擬借重元太在電子材料領域深厚的基礎材料開發與製造技術能力，結合自身在電路板材料領域的研發實力與長期產業經驗，強強聯手、優勢互補，共同布局 AI 高速傳輸材料市場。
依據雙方合作意向書架構設定，雙方將共同推動AI高速傳輸材料的技術開發、製程驗證及委託製造等合作事宜。初步規劃由台虹科技提供關鍵材料，於元太科技新竹及觀音廠區進行製程試產與驗證，並視實際合作進展再行進一步評估後續製造服務等相關事宜。
同時，台虹今天並指出，因長期策略規劃及實際營運需要，與大股東長華電材(8070-TW)簽訂銷售代理合約，於台灣地區代理台虹半導體材料。
台虹 FCCL 產品在提供包括手機及消費電子的應用營收占比達 90%，但今年在面對包括 CCL、被動元件、記憶體等供應鏈零組件等缺貨等供應鏈不確定狀況，對全年的營運看法趨於保守，並努力改善產品銷售結構，預期2026全年營收維持在2025年水準。
已完成在泰國投資設廠營運的台虹科技，目前除 FCCL 產品之外，在開發在新產品包括細線路材料、以 PTFE 填料型的高速銅箔基板及針對暫時性接著需求提供雷射接著材料進行開發，目前開發及銷售進度仍符合預期，其中以細線路高階軟板材料銷售最出色，而半導體材料也進一步進入工程驗證新階段。
而完工且建置完備的台虹泰國廠去年占台虹營收不及 10%。公司指出，泰國廠的生產良率及效率已逐步達到應有的水準，將待時機向市場爭取商機。
paras_en: Tai Hong (8039‑TW), a flexible copper foil substrate maker acquired by Yuan Tai Technology (8069‑TW), announced its latest financial results today (28th). For Q3 2026, after‑tax profit was NT$2.03 billion, down 15.75% quarter‑over‑quarter and down 10.38% year‑over‑year, earnings per share NT$0.77. For the first three quarters of 2026, after‑tax profit was NT$6.15 billion, up 79.93% year‑over‑year, earnings per share NT$2.33.

In Q3 2026, Tai Hong recorded revenue of NT$24.93 billion, gross margin 22.77%, down 0.36 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and up 4.26 percentage points year‑over‑year. After‑tax profit was NT$2.03 billion, down 15.75% QoQ and down 10.38% YoY, EPS NT$0.77.

For the first three quarters of 2026, Tai Hong’s revenue was NT$76.05 billion, gross margin 22.66%, up 3.54 percentage points year‑over‑year, and after‑tax profit was NT$6.15 billion, up 79.93% YoY, EPS NT$2.33.

Today the board approved a memorandum of understanding with E Ink’s Yuan Tai Technology (8069‑TW). Tai Hong intends to leverage Yuan Tai’s deep expertise in basic material development and manufacturing for electronic materials, combine it with its own R&D strength and long‑standing experience in circuit‑board materials, to jointly enter the AI high‑speed transmission material market.

Under the framework of the MOU, the two parties will jointly promote technology development, process verification and contract manufacturing for AI high‑speed transmission materials. The initial plan is for Tai Hong to supply key materials, with trial production and verification carried out at Yuan Tai’s Hsinchu and Guanyin facilities, and further manufacturing services to be evaluated based on the progress of the cooperation.

At the same time, Tai Hong said that, due to long‑term strategic planning and operational needs, it has signed a sales agency agreement with its major shareholder Changhua Electric Materials (8070‑TW) to act as the exclusive agent for Tai Hong’s semiconductor materials in Taiwan.

Tai Hong’s FCCL products, which serve mobile phones and consumer electronics, account for about 90% of its application revenue. However, this year the company faces supply‑chain uncertainties such as shortages of CCL, passive components and memory chips, leading to a more conservative outlook for the full year. It is working to improve its product sales mix and expects 2026 full‑year revenue to remain at the 2025 level.

Having completed the investment and operation of a plant in Thailand, Tai Hong is now developing new products beyond FCCL, including fine‑line materials, PTFE‑filled high‑speed copper‑foil substrates, and laser‑bonding materials for temporary bonding needs. Development and sales are progressing as expected, with fine‑line high‑end flexible board materials showing the strongest sales, while semiconductor materials have moved into a new engineering verification stage.

The newly built and fully equipped Thai plant contributed less than 10% of Tai Hong’s total revenue last year. The company noted that the plant’s yield and efficiency are gradually reaching target levels and that it will seek market opportunities when the timing is right.

items.title: 台鐵與JR東日本簽署MOU 攜手深化台日鐵道交流共創永續與觀光發展
items.title_en: Taiwan Railways and JR East Sign MOU to Deepen Taiwan-Japan Rail Collaboration for Sustainable and Tourism Development
paras: 台鐵公司今(28)日與日本最大鐵道業者之一的東日本旅客鐵路株式會社(JR東日本)發表合作備忘錄(MOU)，未來雙方將建立長期合作交流機制，合作範圍包括鐵道設施維護與天然災害應變、車站及資產開發活化、台日鐵道觀光推廣、前瞻多元領域等4項，雙方透過技術經驗分享、營運交流及觀光推廣合作，共同提升鐵道安全與服務品質。
JR東日本為日本具代表性的鐵道事業機構，在鐵道營運管理、基礎設施維護、車站開發及觀光行銷等領域擁有豐富經驗與卓越成果。台鐵表示，此次雙方簽署合作備忘錄，不僅象徵台日鐵道合作關係邁向新階段，更展現雙方共同致力於促進鐵道技術交流。
台鐵表示，根據MOU內容，與JR東日本將透過意見交換、技術研討、相互考察及人員訪問等方式，推動以下相關交流：
一、鐵道設施維護與天然災害應變：雙方就軌道、橋梁、邊坡等土木結構物維護管理經驗，以及天然災害預防、監測及應變措施進行交流，共同提升鐵道系統韌性與安全管理能力。
二、車站及資產開發活化：針對車站及周邊土地開發、資產活化利用、商業設施管理與營運等議題，分享實務經驗與成功案例，促進雙方資產經營效益提升。
三、台日鐵道觀光推廣：結合雙方鐵道特色及觀光資源，共同推動台日鐵道旅遊行銷與宣傳活動，吸引更多旅客體驗台灣與日本的鐵道文化及沿線觀光魅力，促進兩地觀光與人文交流。
四、前瞻多元領域合作：持續依據產業發展需求及合作成果，擴展更多元的交流合作領域。
台鐵董事長鄭光遠表示，未來將結合雙方專業資源與經驗，深化技術交流，並積極推動智慧化、安全化及永續化的公司發展方向，提供旅客更安全、便捷與優質的服務體驗，共創互利共榮的新局面。
paras_en: Taiwan Railways Administration (TRA) today (the 28th) announced a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with East Japan Railway Company (JR East), one of Japan's largest rail operators. The two parties will establish a long‑term cooperation and exchange mechanism covering four areas: rail infrastructure maintenance and natural disaster response, station and asset development revitalization, Taiwan‑Japan rail tourism promotion, and forward‑looking multi‑sector collaboration. Through sharing technical experience, operational exchanges, and tourism promotion cooperation, they aim to jointly improve rail safety and service quality.

JR East is a flagship rail enterprise in Japan, possessing extensive experience and outstanding results in rail operations management, infrastructure maintenance, station development, and tourism marketing. TRA said that signing this MOU not only marks a new stage in Taiwan‑Japan rail cooperation but also demonstrates both sides' commitment to advancing rail technology exchange.
TRA stated that, according to the MOU, it will work with JR East through opinion exchanges, technical seminars, mutual inspections, and staff visits to promote the following areas of cooperation:

1. Rail infrastructure maintenance and natural disaster response: Both sides will exchange experiences on the maintenance and management of civil structures such as tracks, bridges, and slopes, as well as on natural disaster prevention, monitoring, and response measures, aiming to enhance the resilience and safety management of their rail systems.

2. Station and asset development revitalization: Topics include station and surrounding land development, asset activation, commercial facility management and operation. Practical experiences and successful case studies will be shared to improve the efficiency of asset management for both parties.

3. Taiwan‑Japan rail tourism promotion: By combining each side's rail characteristics and tourism resources, the two will jointly promote rail travel marketing and publicity activities, attracting more travelers to experience the rail culture and scenic attractions of Taiwan and Japan, thereby fostering tourism and cultural exchange between the two regions.

4. Forward‑looking multi‑sector cooperation: Based on industry development needs and the outcomes of existing collaborations, the partnership will expand into additional diverse areas of exchange and cooperation.

TRA Chairman Cheng Kuang‑yuan said that the future will see the integration of both parties' professional resources and experience to deepen technical exchanges, actively advance smart, safe, and sustainable development directions for the company, and provide passengers with safer, more convenient, and higher‑quality service experiences, creating a mutually beneficial and prosperous new landscape.

items.title: 美光勞資協議爆無效？勞部：一般契約不受3年限制 若不服可循司法途徑
items.title_en: Micron Labor-Management Agreement Deemed Invalid? Labor Ministry: General Contracts Not Subject to 3-Year Limit; Disputes Can Be Resolved Through Courts
paras: 針對桃園市產業總工會今(28)日對台灣美光勞資協議內容提出質疑，勞動部回應，台中美光1021協議屬於一般性契約，並無團體協約法最長3年期限之適用。勞動部強調，工會代表經授權簽訂的一般性協議具民法效力，若成員對效力有疑義可循司法民事途徑解決。同時，職工福利金提撥可納入團體協約，並承諾將會同桃園市政府持續協助桃園美光工會與資方協商，期盼雙方盡早達成共識，讓勞資爭議圓滿落幕。

記憶體大廠美光在台灣設有重要生產基地，近期其勞資協議引發外界高度關注。美光在台中與桃園擴建先進製程廠區，整體員工規模龐大。桃園市產業總工會於28日針對美光勞資協議內容提出多項訴求，聚焦協議效力、和平協議條款內容以及員工福利金提撥等爭議。此次勞資雙方對於協議性質的認知差異，不僅牽動美光內部員工權益，也成為台灣科技業勞資關係的重要觀察指標。針對產總的訴求，勞動部迅速出面說明相關法律規範，期望能化解勞資雙方的歧見。
對於外界關注的協議期限與性質，勞動部依據團體協約法第28條規定指出，團體協約期限最長不得超過3年，但如果公司與工會所簽訂之協議為一般性協議，則無該條文之適用。勞動部進一步說明，關於本次台中美光1021協議，根據勞資雙方及主管機關中科管理局的表示，均認定該協議屬於公司與工會所約定之一般性協議。至於引發討論的和平協議條款內容，勞動部認為這部分屬於雙方約定範疇，應由協議雙方親自對外說明較為適當。
針對工會成員對協議效力可能產生的疑慮，勞動部表示，工會依據章程或會員代表大會議決，授權工會代表與公司協商後所簽訂的一般性協議，在法律性質上屬於民法上的一般性契約。如果工會內部成員對於該協議的效力存有疑義，建議可以循司法民事訴訟途徑進行處理，透過法院來釐清契約的合法性與有效性，以保障勞工自身的權益與相關訴求。

針對員工高度關心的福利金提撥問題，勞動部引用團體協約法第12條，該法條明定團體協約得約定的事項，涵蓋工資、工時、申訴制度、促進勞資合作、獎懲、教育訓練、安全衛生、企業福利、其他關於勞資雙方共同遵守之事項，以及其他經團體協約當事人合意之事項。勞動部強調，勞資雙方如果想要透過團體協商，就涉及員工福利的事項進行討論，包括提高職工福利金之提撥上限或提撥數額等，並約定於團體協約之中，在法理上尚無不可，雙方具有充分的協商與調整空間。
針對未來的協商進度，勞動部表示，目前桃園美光工會與美光公司雙方均同意繼續進行協商並尋求共識。為了促成勞資和諧，勞動部承諾將會同桃園市政府持續提供必要的協助，致力於促進勞資雙方更進一步的協商與溝通。勞動部高度期待勞資雙方能夠秉持誠信原則，儘早達成共識，讓此次勞資爭議順利落幕，共同創造企業與員工雙贏的局面，維持產業鏈的穩定發展。
paras_en: In response to the Taoyuan City Industrial Federation’s questions today (the 28th) about the content of Micron Taiwan’s labor‑management agreement, the Ministry of Labor said the Micron Taichung 1021 agreement is a general contract and is not subject to the three‑year maximum term under the Collective Bargaining Act. The ministry emphasized that a general agreement signed by a union representative with proper authorization has the force of a civil law contract, and if members doubt its validity they may pursue civil litigation. It also noted that employee welfare fund contributions can be included in a collective agreement and pledged to work with the Taoyuan municipal government to continue assisting the Taoyuan Micron union and management in negotiations, hoping both sides reach consensus soon and bring the dispute to a satisfactory close.

Micron, a major memory chip maker, operates a significant production base in Taiwan, and its recent labor‑management agreement has drawn intense public attention. The company is expanding advanced‑process facilities in Taichung and Taoyuan, employing a large workforce. On the 28th, the Taoyuan City Industrial Federation raised multiple demands concerning the agreement’s legal effect, the content of a peace‑clause, and employee welfare fund contributions. The differing views on the nature of the agreement affect not only Micron employees’ rights but also serve as a key indicator of labor‑management relations in Taiwan’s tech sector. The Ministry of Labor quickly stepped in to clarify the relevant legal framework in response to the federation’s concerns, aiming to resolve the parties’ disagreements.

Regarding the public’s focus on the agreement’s term and nature, the Ministry of Labor cited Article 28 of the Collective Bargaining Act, which caps collective agreements at three years, but clarified that this limitation does not apply to general contracts signed between a company and a union. The ministry further explained that, according to both the parties and the supervising body, the Central Taiwan Science Park Administration, the Taichung Micron 1021 agreement is classified as a general contract. As for the debated peace‑clause, the ministry said it falls within the scope of the parties’ private arrangements and should be explained directly by the contracting sides.

Addressing union members’ possible doubts about the agreement’s validity, the Ministry of Labor stated that a general contract signed by a union representative after authorization by the union’s constitution or a members’ assembly is, in legal terms, a standard civil contract. If union members question its legality, they are advised to seek resolution through civil court proceedings, allowing a judge to determine the contract’s legality and enforceability and thereby protect workers’ rights and claims.

On the issue of employee welfare fund contributions, the Ministry of Labor cited Article 12 of the Collective Bargaining Act, which enumerates matters that may be stipulated in a collective agreement, including wages, working hours, grievance procedures, labor‑management cooperation, rewards and penalties, training, occupational safety and health, corporate welfare, and any other mutually agreed items. The ministry stressed that if both sides wish to negotiate welfare matters—such as raising the ceiling or amount of employee welfare fund contributions—these can be incorporated into a collective agreement without legal obstacle, giving both parties ample room for negotiation and adjustment.

Looking ahead to future negotiations, the Ministry of Labor said that both the Taoyuan Micron union and Micron have agreed to continue talks and seek common ground. To foster labor‑management harmony, the ministry pledged to work with the Taoyuan municipal government to provide necessary support, facilitating further dialogue. The ministry expressed strong hope that both parties will act in good faith, reach agreement promptly, and bring the dispute to a smooth conclusion, creating a win‑win situation for the company and its employees and maintaining stability in the industry supply chain.

items.title: 聯亞Q3每股賺6.12元寫單季新高 明年產能續擴增營運優於今年
items.title_en: Lianya Q3 EPS Hits NT$6.12, New Quarterly High; Capacity Expansion Continues Next Year, Operating Performance Beats This Year
paras: 三五族光通訊股王聯亞 (3081-TW) 今 (28) 日舉行線上法說會，並公告 2026 年第三季自結財報。受惠 AI 資料中心 (AI DC) 帶動高速光通訊需求升溫，加上矽光子相關產品出貨持續放大，聯亞第三季營收、毛利率、營益率及獲利同步攀升，單季稅後純益達 6.21 億元，季增 33%、年增 5.28 倍，每股純益 (EPS) 6.12 元，雙雙創下單季新高。
聯亞第三季合併營收達 15.62 億元，季增 28%、年增 183%；毛利率 58.56%，季增約 1.1 個百分點；營益率則達 49%。累計今年前三季營收 36.88 億元，年增 136%；稅後純益 14.07 億元，年增 491%，前三季 EPS 達 13.88 元，獲利較去年同期大幅成長。
展望第四季，聯亞財務長楊吉裕表示，受惠矽光子需求持續旺盛，預期本季營收季增幅度將與去年第四季相當，約為 16%。目前主要客戶已開始下達超過 6 個月的長期訂單，隨著公司合作夥伴持續擴增產能，預期第四季及未來數季矽光子產品出貨量都將持續成長。
針對產能規劃及資本支出展望，楊吉裕指出，目前聯亞 CW Laser（連續波雷射）及上游磷化銦 (InP) 磊晶產品出貨均相當暢旺。其中，CW Laser 已在 800G、1.6T 等規格進入量產，且產品利潤較短波長雷射高出近 50%，是公司具技術優勢的重要產品線。
為因應客戶需求，聯亞日前已與美系大型客戶簽訂長期供貨合約，近期並追加 30 億元資本支出。若加計過去一年累計投入的資本支出，總額已超過 80 億元，資金將主要用於擴充產能。
楊吉裕表示，聯亞目標在 2027 年將產能擴增至目前的 2.5 倍，2028 年再以 2027 年為基礎擴增至 2.5 倍，換言之，未來兩年產能可望較目前提升近 6 倍，以滿足持續增加的客戶需求。
楊吉裕進一步指出，目前公司訂單量仍高於產能，整體供貨處於供不應求狀態，預期隨著明年新產能陸續開出，營運表現將優於今年。
至於持續加碼資本支出的原因，楊吉裕解釋，公司會依客戶需求滾動調整擴產計畫，目前客戶訂單能見度均超過 6 個月，在手訂單金額也已超過今年全年營收規模，因此公司有信心持續投入資金擴產，迎接後續需求成長。
paras_en: Lianya (3081-TW), the leader in optical communications among the 35‑group stocks, held an online earnings conference today (28th) and released its Q3 2026 financial results. Benefiting from AI data center (AI‑DC) driven surge in high‑speed optical communications demand and continued growth in silicon‑photonic product shipments, Lianya saw its revenue, gross margin, operating margin and profit all rise in the quarter, posting a net profit after tax of NT$621 million – up 33% quarter‑over‑quarter and 5.28‑fold year‑over‑year – with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$6.12, both setting new quarterly records.

In Q3, Lianya’s consolidated revenue reached NT$1.562 billion, up 28% quarter‑over‑quarter and 183% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 58.56%, roughly 1.1 percentage points higher than the prior quarter; operating margin hit 49%. For the first three quarters of the year, cumulative revenue was NT$3.688 billion, up 136% YoY; net profit after tax was NT$1.407 billion, up 491% YoY, and EPS for the first three quarters was NT$13.88, a substantial increase from the same period last year.

Looking ahead to Q4, CFO Yang Jiyu said that strong silicon‑photonic demand will likely keep the quarter‑over‑quarter revenue growth at about the same level as Q4 last year, roughly 16%. Major customers have already placed long‑term orders extending beyond six months, and as the company’s partners keep expanding capacity, shipments of silicon‑photonic products are expected to keep rising in Q4 and the subsequent quarters.

Regarding capacity planning and capex outlook, Yang noted that shipments of Lianya’s CW (continuous‑wave) lasers and upstream indium phosphide (InP) epitaxial products are both very robust. The CW lasers have entered mass production in 800 Gb/s and 1.6 Tb/s specifications, and their profit margins are about 50% higher than those of short‑wave lasers, making this a key product line with a technological edge.

To meet customer demand, Lianya recently signed a long‑term supply agreement with a major U.S. client and has added NT$3 billion of capital expenditure. Including the capital spent over the past year, total capex now exceeds NT$8 billion, with the funds primarily earmarked for capacity expansion.

Yang said Lianya aims to increase its capacity to 2.5 times the current level by 2027, and then again to 2.5 times that 2027 level by 2028. In other words, capacity is expected to be nearly six times the present level within two years to satisfy the growing customer demand.

Yang further pointed out that the company’s order backlog still exceeds its current capacity, resulting in a supply‑shortage situation. He expects that as new capacity comes online next year, operating performance will surpass this year’s results.

Regarding the continued increase in capex, Yang explained that the company will adjust its expansion plans in a rolling manner based on customer demand. Current order visibility extends beyond six months, and the value of orders on hand already exceeds the full‑year revenue forecast, giving the company confidence to keep investing in capacity to meet future demand growth.

items.title: 台虹董事會通過與元太合作意向 攜手布局AI高速傳輸材料市場
items.title_en: Tai Hong Board Approves Cooperation Intent with E Ink Yuantai to Jointly Enter AI High-Speed Transmission Materials Market
paras: 軟板材料廠台虹科技(8039-TW)今(28)日宣布，董事會通過與全球電子紙領導廠商E Ink元太科技(8069-TW)簽訂合作意向書，台虹擬借重元太在電子材料領域深厚的基礎材料開發與製造技術能力，結合自身在電路板材料領域的研發實力與長期產業經驗，強強聯手、優勢互補，共同布局 AI 高速傳輸材料市場。
台虹指出，此一雙方合作將可快速回應客戶對高性能材料、量產能力及穩定供應的期待與需求。初步規劃由台虹科技提供關鍵材料，於元太科技新竹及觀音廠區進行製程試產與驗證。

台虹科技董事長陳永恒表示，隨著AI技術快速發展，高頻高速材料的重要性日益提升。台虹科技長期深耕銅箔基板及高階電子材料領域，藉由累積多年的電路板材料專業能力，積極投入PTFE材料的技術與產品開發。台虹看好AI高速傳輸材料市場的發展潛力，將透過結合元太科技在基礎材料開發、表面處理及跨國量產管理方面的豐富經驗，以及台虹科技在高階電路板材料領域的研發實力，發揮雙方技術與製造資源的互補優勢，加速PTFE材料的開發與量產進程，致力於提供滿足客戶需求之高速傳輸材料，強強聯手切入AI高階材料供應鏈，掌握AI產業發展帶來的新契機。
依據雙方合作意向書架構設定，雙方將共同推動AI高速傳輸材料的技術開發、製程驗證及委託製造等合作事宜。初步規劃由台虹科技提供關鍵材料，於元太科技新竹及觀音廠區進行製程試產與驗證，並視實際合作進展再行進一步評估後續製造服務等相關事宜。
台虹指出，本合作意向書仍待元太科技董事會審議，相關商業條件及執行細節，將由董事會授權執行進一步協商，並以最終經核准的正式簽署合約為準。
paras_en: Tai Hong Technology (8039-TW), a flexible circuit material maker, announced today (28th) that its board approved a cooperation intent letter with global e‑paper leader E Ink Yuantai Technology (8069‑TW). Tai Hong plans to leverage Yuantai’s deep expertise in basic electronic material development and manufacturing, combine it with its own R&D strength and long‑term experience in circuit board materials, and jointly target the AI high‑speed transmission material market.

Tai Hong said the partnership will quickly meet customers’ expectations for high‑performance materials, mass‑production capacity and stable supply. Initially, Tai Hong will provide key materials, and pilot production and verification will be carried out at Yuantai’s Hsinchu and Guanyin facilities.

Chairman Chen Yong‑heng of Tai Hong Technology stated that as AI technology rapidly advances, the importance of high‑frequency, high‑speed materials is growing. Tai Hong, which has long focused on copper‑foil substrates and advanced electronic materials, is actively developing PTFE material technology and products based on its accumulated circuit‑board material expertise. He expressed confidence in the market potential of AI high‑speed transmission materials and said that by combining Yuantai’s rich experience in basic material development, surface treatment and multinational mass production management with Tai Hong’s R&D strength in advanced circuit‑board materials, the two companies can complement each other’s technical and manufacturing resources, accelerate PTFE material development and mass production, and provide high‑speed transmission materials that meet customer needs, thereby entering the AI high‑end material supply chain and seizing new opportunities from AI industry growth.

According to the framework of the cooperation intent letter, the parties will jointly promote technology development, process verification and contract manufacturing for AI high‑speed transmission materials. The initial plan is for Tai Hong to supply key materials while Yuantai conducts pilot production and verification at its Hsinchu and Guanyin sites, with further manufacturing services to be evaluated as the collaboration progresses.

Tai Hong noted that the intent letter still requires review by Yuantai’s board, and that commercial terms and execution details will be authorized by the board for further negotiation, with the final approved signed contract taking precedence.

items.title: Fed在提醒市場別押太多？華爾街分析師對升息前景看法分歧
items.title_en: Is the Fed Warning the Market Not to Over‑bet? Wall Street Analysts Split on Rate‑Hike Outlook
paras: 聯準會(Fed)周三(28日)維持利率不變，但華爾街對決策釋出的訊號看法分歧。部分分析師認為，僅兩名官員主張升息，加上聲明強調等待更多資訊，意味市場對後續緊縮的預期可能過高；另一些人則指出，Fed將經濟成長描述由「穩健」上調為「強勁」，搭配持續偏高的通膨，仍支持12月恢復升息。
Fed本次以10票贊成、2票反對，將聯邦基金利率目標區間維持於3.75%至4%。理事庫克與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克主張升息1碼。聲明表示，累積更多資訊將有助判斷適當政策立場，以確保通膨及時回到2%目標。

等待更多數據 是偏鴿訊號還是升息前的暫停

Harris Financial Group管理合夥人Jamie Cox認為，Fed是在提醒市場，投資人預期的升息幅度可能超過央行實際準備採取的行動。他將「依賴數據」解讀為，除非情勢迫使Fed出手，否則官員暫時不想進一步調整政策。
Corpay首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta則認為，這次僅有兩票反對，少於許多人原先預期的三至四票，算是略偏鴿派的意外。不過，Fed同時上調對經濟的評價，應足以讓市場理解，後續仍可能進一步緊縮。
Annex Wealth Management首席經濟策略師Brian Jacobsen表示，理事投下反對票令人略感意外，但更值得注意的是，Fed將經濟成長描述由「穩健」改為「強勁」。他質疑，在部分就業與成長指標已降溫之際，央行為何反而提高評價。
Jacobsen指出，ADP每周就業增幅的移動平均值，在7月至9月會議之間呈上升趨勢，但此後已轉弱；亞特蘭大聯準銀行GDPNow模型顯示的成長熱度也有所下降。
他認為，這或許解釋了聲明為何採取較模糊的政策措辭。9月Fed曾表示升息是「移除部分寬鬆」，暗示利率仍偏低；本次改稱需要更多資訊來判斷，則讓目前政策是否仍過於寬鬆的答案變得不明確。

高盛估12月恢復升息 明年仍有加碼緊縮風險

高盛資產管理固定收益與流動性解決方案全球主管暨投資長Kay Haigh預期，Fed將於12月恢復升息。她指出，9月強勁的消費者物價指數(CPI)再次提醒市場，通膨上行風險仍在，央行可能透過進一步升息，為這些風險預作防範。
Haigh表示，雖然9月利率點陣圖暗示今年只會再升息一次，但若能源價格再度上揚，或後續經濟數據持續強勁，明年仍可能需要額外緊縮。
Natixis美國首席經濟學家Christopher Hodge的看法更為鮮明。他認為，通膨仍是問題，經濟成長維持穩健，失業率也大致穩定，12月升息幾乎已成定局。真正需要解釋的是，既然最終仍須行動，為何現在要延後？
Hodge指出，這次暫停符合紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯與副主席傑佛遜先前釋出的訊號，即目前沒有連續升息的急迫性。他也推測，兩次會議之間的資產價格波動與部分科技股走弱，可能已帶來一定程度的金融緊縮，讓Fed選擇多等一些數據。
他預期，主席華許可能會強調，Fed觀察的是整體趨勢，而非單一數據，但這樣的回答未必足以滿足市場對暫停理由的疑問。

油價衝擊難靠升息化解 官員面臨政策效果爭論

Motley Fool Asset Management首席投資策略師Bill Mann認為，聲明強調需要「更多資訊」，反映Fed內部可能對石油價格究竟造成多少通膨壓力，存在明顯分歧。
Mann表示，貨幣政策無法直接解決地緣政治造成的失衡。他也質疑，在當前決策中，2%通膨目標是否真的是Fed最優先考量，認為官員重申目標的表態成分較高。
這些評論凸顯華爾街的核心分歧：若通膨壓力主要來自能源與供應衝擊，等待更多資訊有其道理；但若物價壓力持續擴散，且經濟足以承受緊縮，延後升息也可能增加日後控制通膨的難度。

利率不動不等於借貸壓力解除

TransUnion全球研究與顧問主管Charlie Wise表示，Fed此次決策反映其持續權衡通膨風險，以及仍具韌性的經濟與就業情勢。即使近期通膨高於預期，官員仍選擇先評估9月升息的影響，並觀察穩定的勞動市場。
對消費者而言，暫停升息意味信用卡借貸成本暫時不會因本次政策決策而進一步提高，但利率風險並未消失。Wise提醒，隨著假期消費旺季到來，若通膨持續、利率長期居高不下，累積較大的信用卡未償餘額仍可能帶來沉重成本。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged on Wednesday (the 28th), but Wall Street was divided over the signal the decision sent. Some analysts said that only two officials favored a hike and the statement’s emphasis on waiting for more data meant the market may be over‑estimating the likelihood of further tightening; others pointed out that the Fed upgraded its view of economic growth from “steady” to “strong” and, together with still‑elevated inflation, still supports a rate increase in December.

The Fed voted 10‑2 to keep the federal‑funds target range at 3.75%‑4.00%. Board member Cook and Cleveland Fed President Harker each voted for a one‑basis‑point hike. The statement said that gathering more information will help determine the appropriate policy stance to ensure inflation returns to the 2% target in a timely manner.

Waiting for more data – a dovish signal or a pause before another hike? Jamie Cox, managing partner at Harris Financial Group, said the Fed is reminding the market that investors may be expecting larger hikes than the central bank is prepared to deliver. He reads “relying on data” as meaning that unless conditions force the Fed’s hand, officials do not want to adjust policy further for now.

Corpay chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said the two dissenting votes were fewer than the three‑to‑four many had expected, a slightly dovish surprise. However, the Fed’s upgraded economic outlook should be enough for the market to understand that further tightening remains possible.

Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management, said the dissenting votes were a mild surprise, but the more noteworthy point was the Fed’s shift in describing growth from “steady” to “strong.” He questioned why the central bank would raise its assessment when some employment and growth indicators have already cooled.

Jacobsen noted that the moving average of weekly ADP job gains rose between the July‑September meetings but has since weakened, and the Atlanta Fed’s GDPNow model also shows a slowdown in growth momentum.

He believes this may explain why the statement used more ambiguous policy language. In September the Fed said a hike would “remove some accommodation,” implying rates were still low; this time it said more information is needed to judge, leaving the question of whether policy is still too accommodative unclear.

Goldman Sachs estimates a December rate hike, with continued tightening risk next year. Kay Haigh, global head of fixed‑income and liquidity solutions at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, expects the Fed to resume hikes in December. She noted that September’s strong CPI again reminded the market that inflation‑upside risks remain, and the central bank may pre‑emptively tighten further to guard against those risks.

Haigh added that although the September rate‑dot plot suggested only one more hike this year, a resurgence in energy prices or persistently strong economic data could require additional tightening next year.

Natixis U.S. chief economist Christopher Hodge was even more blunt. He said inflation remains a problem, growth stays solid and unemployment is roughly stable, making a December hike almost a foregone conclusion. The real question, he argued, is why the Fed is delaying action now if it ultimately has to act.

Hodge pointed out that the pause aligns with signals previously given by New York Fed President Williams and Vice‑Chair Jefferson that there is no urgent need for consecutive hikes. He also speculated that asset‑price volatility and weakness in some tech stocks between the two meetings may have already introduced a degree of financial tightening, giving the Fed room to wait for more data.

He expects Chair Waller may stress that the Fed is looking at the overall trend rather than any single data point, but that answer may not fully satisfy the market’s demand for a clear rationale for the pause.

Motley Fool Asset Management chief investment strategist Bill Mann said the statement’s emphasis on “more information” reflects an internal split at the Fed over how much oil price shocks are feeding inflation.

Mann argued that monetary policy cannot directly solve the imbalances caused by geopolitical events. He also questioned whether the 2% inflation target is truly the Fed’s top priority in the current decision‑making, suggesting that officials are largely restating the target for political reasons.

These comments highlight the core Wall Street divide: if inflation pressure is mainly from energy and supply shocks, waiting for more data makes sense; but if price pressures keep spreading and the economy can absorb tightening, postponing hikes could make future inflation control harder.

Charlie Wise, head of global research and consulting at TransUnion, said the Fed’s decision reflects its ongoing weighing of inflation risks against a still‑resilient economy and labor market. Even though recent inflation has been higher than expected, officials chose to first assess the impact of the September hike and watch a stable labor market.

For consumers, a pause means credit‑card borrowing costs won’t rise immediately because of this policy move, but interest‑rate risk remains. Wise warned that as the holiday‑spending season approaches, persistent inflation and sustained high rates could make large outstanding credit‑card balances very costly.

paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)結束為期兩天的政策會議後，於台灣時間周四(29日)凌晨2時公布利率決策，聯邦基金利率目標區間維持在3.75-4.00%，符合市場預期。以下是Fed 10月會議聲明，與上一次9月會議聲明相比的措詞差異：

聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)以10票對2票批准發布以下聲明：

paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) concluded its two‑day policy meeting and, at 2 a.m. Taiwan time on Thursday the 29th, announced its interest‑rate decision, keeping the federal funds rate target range at 3.75‑4.00%, in line with market expectations. Below is the full text of the October meeting statement.
The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) approved the following statement by a vote of 10 to 2:

The Committee decided to keep the federal funds rate target range at 3.75‑4.00% to support the Fed’s dual mandate. The Committee continues its policy of maintaining ample reserves in the banking system.

Economic activity is expanding at a strong pace. Although some uncertainty remains high due to developments in geopolitical situations, domestic spending has remained resilient. Productivity growth is robust, and capital investment is also fairly solid. Employment growth is keeping pace with the labor force, and the unemployment rate has changed little.

Inflation remains elevated. As more information becomes available, the Federal Open Market Committee will be able to further assess the appropriate policy stance to ensure inflation returns in a timely manner to the Committee’s 2% target. The Committee will achieve price stability.
Opposing monetary‑policy action were Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack, both of whom preferred to raise the federal funds rate target range by 0.25 percentage point at this meeting.
