items.title: Fed按兵不動、鷹派不退！兩官員投反對票 市場估12月升息機率逾八成
items.title_en: Fed Holds Steady, Hawks Unwavering! Two Officials Cast Dissenting Votes, Market Prices Over 80% Chance of a December Rate Hike
paras: 聯準會(Fed)周三(28日)以10票贊成、2票反對，決議維持聯邦基金利率目標區間於3.75%至4%，在9月升息後暫時按兵不動。理事庫克(Lisa Cook)與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)投下反對票，主張本次應再升息1碼(25個基點)。
Fed重申，通膨仍處高檔，將透過更多資訊判斷適當政策立場，確保通膨及時回到2%目標，並強調「將實現物價穩定」。聲明雖未明確預告12月升息，市場仍高度預期年底前將再度緊縮。根據芝商所FedWatch工具，截稿時市場預估12月升息1碼的機率約85%。
《華爾街日報》記者、有「Fed傳聲筒」之稱的Nick Timiraos指出，此次暫停升息，是為了爭取時間評估能源成本與人工智慧(AI)建設熱潮是否進一步推升廣泛物價壓力，聲明也未明顯挑戰華爾街對12月可能再度升息的預期。9月公布的預測顯示，多數官員當時認為，今年至少還須升息一次，時間落在本次會議或12月9日結束的下次會議。

庫克首度投下反對票 關切AI建設推升通膨

哈瑪克過去曾支持更緊縮的政策，最近一次是在7月投下主張升息的反對票。她認為，及早進行較小幅度的調整，有助避免未來被迫採取幅度更大、可能更具破壞性的升息。
庫克此次則是加入決策委員會逾四年來，首次投下反對票。她近期表示，AI基礎建設熱潮是她對明年前景最關切的議題，因為相關投資已造成通膨壓力，而且可能不會很快消退。不過，另外兩名7月曾與哈瑪克一同支持升息的官員，本次轉而支持維持利率不變，顯示官員對行動時機仍有分歧。
Fed聲明指出，經濟活動強勁擴張，儘管地緣政治等因素使不確定性居高不下，國內支出仍具韌性，生產力成長與資本投資表現強勁。就業成長與勞動力增長同步，失業率變化不大，Fed也將持續維持銀行體系準備金充裕。
美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)漲幅創五個月來最大，主要受到伊朗戰爭推升能源價格影響，但商品與服務價格也呈現廣泛上漲，讓Fed面臨的物價壓力不僅限於能源。

暫停不代表升息結束 通膨預期成政策關鍵

市場對本次決策的預期，近幾周曾大幅轉變。9月升息後，聯邦基金期貨一度反映10月再升息的機率超過70%；但紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯與副主席傑佛森隨後表示，9月行動已爭取到評估經濟的時間，升息預期因而迅速降溫。
Fed主席華許10月16日也曾表示，9月會議後的情勢大致符合預期，被市場解讀為未打算改變按兵不動的預期。
據《華爾街日報》報導，官員大致認為利率可能仍須進一步提高，但背後理由不盡相同。部分官員認為，現有利率不足以抑制借貸與支出；另一些官員則將升息視為風險管理工具，避免多年高於目標的通膨，讓企業與消費者逐漸接受更頻繁的漲價。
美國通膨已連續逾五年高於Fed的2%目標，2026年也可能成為連續第二個未朝目標取得進展的年度。前Fed資深經濟學家、現任耶魯管理學院教授William English認為，Fed可能仍須小幅升息，但未必需要立即行動，關鍵在於長期高通膨是否使民眾與企業對未來物價的預期升高。
另一名前Fed經濟學家、研究機構Underlying Inflation創辦人Riccardo Trezzi則認為，風險管理反而支持本次升息。他估計，Fed偏好的核心通膨指標9月單月漲幅換算成年率可能達4%，批發物價數據也顯示，後續仍有成本壓力待傳導至消費端。

AI投資與能源衝擊交織 升息效果面臨考驗

本輪通膨壓力與傳統景氣過熱有所不同。AI熱潮推升資料中心、晶片與電力投資，且愈來愈仰賴舉債融資；相關股市漲勢也透過財富效果，支撐高所得家庭消費。另一方面，能源價格與關稅提高企業成本，但勞動市場並未出現明顯過熱跡象。
這讓Fed必須評估，升息究竟能對這些無法直接控制的因素發揮多大作用。調高利率不能增加石油供應，也難以直接阻止科技巨頭競相興建資料中心，但仍可能藉由抑制需求，減緩能源成本向其他商品與服務價格擴散。
前達拉斯聯準銀行總裁、現任高盛(GS-US)副董事長卡普蘭指出，供應衝擊若持續夠久，就不再只是短暫衝擊；即使Fed無法消除供應中斷，仍可降低需求，限制柴油等成本上漲的外溢影響。
對家庭而言，此次維持利率不變未必帶來明顯喘息空間。市場仍預期明年可能進一步升息，而房貸利率追隨的長期美債殖利率也已走高，信用卡、汽車貸款與購屋融資成本仍受壓力。
接下來，市場將聚焦周四(29日)公布的第三季國內生產毛額(GDP)初值與9月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)。經濟學家預估，第三季經濟以年率計算成長約3.2%，相關數據將提供判斷12月政策方向的新線索。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday (the 28th) voted 10‑to‑2 to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 3.75%‑4.0%, pausing after the September hike. Board member Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack cast the dissenting votes, arguing for another 25‑basis‑point increase this time.

The Fed reiterated that inflation remains elevated and that it will use more data to gauge the appropriate policy stance, ensuring inflation returns to the 2% target and emphasizing that “price stability will be achieved.” Although the statement did not explicitly forecast a December hike, markets still heavily expect another tightening before year‑end. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, at the close of the article the market estimated about an 85% probability of a 25‑basis‑point hike in December.

Wall Street Journal reporter Nick Timiraos, often called the Fed’s “mouthpiece,” noted that the pause was intended to buy time to assess whether rising energy costs and the AI construction boom are further feeding broad‑based price pressures, and the statement did not markedly challenge Wall Street’s expectation of a possible December hike. September forecasts showed most officials then believed at least one more hike was needed this year, either at this meeting or at the next meeting ending on Dec. 9.

Cook’s first dissenting vote was driven by concerns that AI‑related spending could stoke inflation. Hammack, who previously supported tighter policy – most recently casting a dissenting vote for a hike in July – said that making a modest adjustment early helps avoid having to take larger, potentially more disruptive hikes later.

Cook, who has been on the policy committee for just over four years, voted against the rate‑hold for the first time. She recently said the AI infrastructure boom is her biggest worry for the coming year because the related investment is already adding inflationary pressure and may not dissipate quickly. The other two officials who had backed a hike with Hammack in July switched to supporting a steady rate this time, showing continued disagreement over timing.

The Fed’s statement highlighted that economic activity is expanding robustly, and despite high geopolitical uncertainty, domestic spending remains resilient, productivity growth and capital investment are strong, employment and labor‑force growth are in sync, the unemployment rate is relatively unchanged, and the Fed will keep bank‑system reserves ample.

U.S. consumer‑price inflation in September posted its biggest rise in five months, driven mainly by higher energy prices amid the Iran war, but goods and services prices also rose broadly, meaning the Fed’s price pressures extend beyond energy.

A pause does not mean the end of hikes; inflation expectations are now a key policy lever. Market expectations for the decision shifted dramatically in recent weeks. After the September hike, fed‑funds futures at one point implied over a 70% chance of another hike in October, but New York Fed President Williams and Vice‑Chair Jefferson later said the September action bought time to assess the economy, quickly cooling rate‑hike expectations.
Fed Chair Waller also said on Oct. 16 that the post‑September situation was broadly as expected, which markets read as a signal that the “hold” stance would remain unchanged.

According to the Wall Street Journal, officials generally agree rates may still need to rise further, but for different reasons. Some say current rates are insufficient to curb borrowing and spending; others view hikes as a risk‑management tool to prevent years of inflation above target and to get firms and consumers accustomed to more frequent price increases.

U.S. inflation has run above the Fed’s 2% goal for more than five consecutive years and could become the second straight year in 2026 without progress toward the target. Former Fed economist and current Yale School of Management professor William English believes the Fed may still need a modest hike, though not necessarily immediately, with the key question being whether persistently high inflation is raising long‑term price expectations among households and businesses.

Another former Fed economist and founder of the research firm Underlying Inflation, Riccardo Trezzi, argues that risk management actually supports a hike this time. He estimates the Fed‑preferred core inflation metric’s September monthly gain, annualized, could be as high as 4%, and wholesale‑price data also show lingering cost pressures that could filter through to consumer prices.

AI investment and energy shocks are intertwining, putting the effectiveness of rate hikes to the test. This round of inflation pressure differs from traditional overheating. The AI boom is driving spending on data centers, chips and electricity, increasingly financed by debt; related equity gains are also creating a wealth effect that supports high‑income household consumption. At the same time, higher energy prices and tariffs are raising corporate costs, but the labor market shows no clear signs of overheating.

That forces the Fed to assess how much rate hikes can influence factors it cannot directly control. Raising rates won’t increase oil supply nor directly stop tech giants from building data centers, but it may dampen demand enough to slow the transmission of energy‑cost spikes into other goods and services.

Former Dallas Fed president and current Goldman Sachs vice‑chairman Kaplan noted that if supply‑side shocks persist long enough they become more than a temporary blip; even if the Fed cannot eliminate supply disruptions, it can still curb demand and limit the spillover of cost rises in diesel and other inputs.

For households, the steady‑rate decision may not provide much breathing room. Markets still expect another hike next year, and long‑term Treasury yields that drive mortgage rates have already risen, keeping credit‑card, auto‑loan and home‑loan costs under pressure.

Going forward, markets will focus on Thursday’s (the 29th) release of the third‑quarter GDP advance estimate and September personal‑consumption‑expenditures (PCE) price index. Economists project Q3 growth at about a 3.2% annualized rate, and the data will offer new clues for judging the policy direction in December.

items.title: 果粉準備好了？首款觸控MacBook Pro台灣周五開放預訂 售價近10萬元起
items.title_en: Are Fans Ready? First Touchscreen MacBook Pro Opens Pre‑orders in Taiwan Friday, Prices Near NT$100,000
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周三(28日)發表首款觸控螢幕MacBook Pro，打破近20年來反對觸控筆電的立場。新機首度將OLED面板與動態島導入Mac，搭載針對觸控重新設計的操作介面，提供M5 Pro與M5 Max晶片選項，機身也更薄、更輕，成為執行長特納斯上任後又一項重大產品變革。
根據蘋果台灣官網，搭載ProLED XDR顯示器的新款MacBook Pro，售價新台幣97,900元起，將於周五(30日)上午9時開放預訂，11月6日正式開賣。

觸控 OLED與動態島首度齊聚Mac

新款MacBook Pro提供14吋與16吋兩種尺寸，美國起售價分別為2,899美元與3,399美元，均較既有機型明顯提高。除了首次搭載OLED觸控螢幕，也將iPhone使用者熟悉的動態島帶到Mac。
特納斯在洛杉磯向媒體與分析師表示：「沒錯，我們首次將觸控帶到Mac。」新機仍執行macOS，展示影片中可見使用者直接滑動螢幕操作影片與影像，機身上蓋也配備發光蘋果標誌。蘋果表示，新螢幕提供更高亮度、更佳色彩與更寬廣的可視角度。
蘋果過去長期抗拒觸控筆電。共同創辦人賈伯斯曾批評這類設計在人體工學上「糟透了」，庫克也曾將筆電與平板結合，比喻為把冰箱和烤麵包機合而為一。特納斯2021年仍主張，iPad與Mac分別針對觸控及間接輸入最佳化，沒有改變的理由。
不過，據《彭博》報導，庫克與特納斯約四年前開始支持MacBook Pro採用觸控螢幕，希望透過高階功能與更高售價，為Mac帶來新動能並增加營收。
這也是特納斯上任後第三次重大產品發布。本周蘋果已推出搭載M6的入門款MacBook Pro與iMac，以及改用OLED螢幕的iPad mini；摺疊iPhone「Duo」則於上周五開賣，延續密集新品攻勢。

筆電市場低迷 蘋果押注操作體驗與裝置端AI

新品問世之際，筆電市場正遭遇嚴峻低潮，全年出貨量預估下滑11%。分析師指出，AI需求引發全球記憶體供應吃緊，推高筆電價格，也壓抑消費意願。
IDC估計，第三季全球個人電腦出貨量年減20%，蘋果也下滑11%。蘋果同樣難逃記憶體漲價壓力，今年幾乎所有Mac產品都已調漲售價，8月推出的Mac mini就加價300美元。
儘管如此，Mac的策略地位持續提高。最近一季Mac營收為103.5億美元，占公司總營收不到一成，但仍深受軟體開發者青睞，也是開發iPhone應用程式唯一受支援的平台。
蘋果近月更強調自研晶片與記憶體架構適合執行裝置端AI。本月也與Meta(META-US)共同宣布，透過高速線材串接多台Mac，可執行接近頂尖水準的大型AI模型，為開發者提供雲端服務之外的選擇。
不過，觸控能否帶動換機仍待觀察。IDC副總裁Ryan Reith指出，今年全球筆電出貨中，觸控機型僅占17%，通常不是購機主因。對蘋果而言，關鍵在於介面與軟體體驗，而觸控可能成為吸引開發者的另一項功能。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL‑US) announced its first touchscreen MacBook Pro on Wednesday (28th), breaking its nearly 20‑year stance against touch laptops. The new device introduces OLED panels and a dynamic island to the Mac for the first time, featuring a touch‑optimized interface and options for M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, while the chassis is thinner and lighter, marking another major product shift under CEO Ternus.

According to Apple’s Taiwan website, the new MacBook Pro with a ProLED XDR display starts at NT$97,900 and will open pre‑orders at 9:00 a.m. on Friday (30th), with official sales beginning on November 6th.

The new MacBook Pro comes in 14‑inch and 16‑inch sizes, with U.S. launch prices of $2,899 and $3,399 respectively, both noticeably higher than existing models. In addition to the first OLED touchscreen, it brings the dynamic island familiar to iPhone users to the Mac.

Ternus told reporters and analysts in Los Angeles, “Yes, we’re bringing touch to the Mac for the first time.” The device still runs macOS, and the video shows users sliding the screen to control video and images, with a glowing Apple logo on the lid. Apple says the new screen offers higher brightness, better color, and a wider viewing angle.

Apple has long resisted touch laptops. Co‑founder Jobs once criticized such designs as “horribly ergonomic,” and Cook likened a laptop‑tablet hybrid to a fridge‑toaster combo. Ternus in 2021 still argued that iPad and Mac should remain optimized for touch and indirect input respectively, with no reason to change.

Bloomberg reports that Cook and Ternus began supporting a touchscreen MacBook Pro about four years ago, hoping to bring new momentum and revenue to the Mac line through high‑end features and higher prices.

This is Ternus’s third major product launch since taking office. This week Apple released an entry‑level MacBook Pro and iMac with M6, an iPad mini with OLED, and the foldable iPhone “Duo” went on sale last Friday, continuing a dense new‑product push.

At the time of the launch, the laptop market is in a severe downturn, with annual shipments expected to decline 11%. Analysts note that AI demand has tightened global memory supply, driving up laptop prices and dampening consumer willingness to buy.

IDC estimates that global PC shipments fell 20% YoY in Q3, with Apple down 11%. Apple also faces memory price pressure, raising prices on almost all Mac products this year, including a $300 increase for the Mac mini launched in August.

Despite this, Mac’s strategic position continues to rise. In the last quarter, Mac revenue was $10.35 billion, less than 10% of total company revenue, yet it remains highly favored by software developers and is the only platform that supports iPhone app development.

Apple has recently emphasized that its in‑house chips and memory architecture are well suited for on‑device AI. This month it announced with Meta (META‑US) that connecting multiple Macs via high‑speed cables can run near‑state‑of‑the‑art large AI models, offering developers an alternative to cloud services.

However, whether touch will drive upgrades remains to be seen. IDC VP Ryan Reith noted that touch laptops account for only 17% of global shipments this year, usually not the main purchase driver. For Apple, the key lies in interface and software experience, and touch could become another feature that attracts developers.

items.title: 才發表新品就裁員！亞馬遜裝置部門裁員約250人
items.title_en: Just Launched New Products, Then Layoffs! Amazon's Devices Division Cuts About 250 Jobs
paras: 亞馬遜(AMZN-US)新品密集登場之際，也同步調整人力。《路透》報導，亞馬遜周三(28日)在裝置與服務部門裁員約250人，主要涉及軟體開發人員。同日，公司才宣布推出搭載Alexa的智慧鬧鐘與數位相框。
亞馬遜在《路透》詢問後證實裁員。公司發言人表示：「我們做出了裁減少量職位的艱難決定。」但未進一步說明細節。據知情人士透露，此次受影響職位不超過250個。
發言人表示，這項調整將協助公司「更有效率地營運，並更符合產品發展規畫」。過去幾周，亞馬遜接連推出新款Kindle電子書閱讀器、平板電腦等產品，如今一邊擴充裝置陣容，一邊縮減相關部門人力。
依照公司慣例，受影響員工於周三清晨收到簡訊與電子郵件通知。《路透》看到的一封郵件，由裝置與服務部門人力資源副總裁Cherie Robinson發出，內容指出，公司已對組織架構進行「全面檢視」，並因此決定裁減職位。
這並非亞馬遜本月首波人力調整。公司本月稍早已在核心零售部門裁減約1,000個職位，最新裁員則延伸至裝置與服務業務。亞馬遜預計於周四(29日)美股盤後公布第三季財報。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) is rolling out a wave of new products while simultaneously adjusting its workforce. Reuters reported that on Wednesday (the 28th) Amazon laid off roughly 250 employees in its Devices and Services division, primarily software developers. The same day, the company announced the launch of an Alexa‑enabled smart alarm clock and a digital photo frame.

Amazon confirmed the layoffs after Reuters’ inquiry. A company spokesperson said, “We have made the difficult decision to reduce a small number of positions,” but did not provide further details. Insiders said the number of affected roles does not exceed 250.

The spokesperson added that the adjustment will help the company “operate more efficiently and align better with product development plans.” In recent weeks Amazon has introduced new Kindle e‑readers, tablets and other devices, expanding its hardware lineup while trimming staff in the related division.

As per company practice, the affected employees received text messages and emails early Wednesday morning. Reuters saw one such email, sent by Cherie Robinson, vice‑president of human resources for Devices and Services, which stated that the organization had undergone a “comprehensive review” and consequently decided to cut positions.

This is not Amazon’s first workforce adjustment this month. Earlier in the month the company cut about 1,000 jobs in its core retail segment, and the latest layoffs extend to the Devices and Services business. Amazon expects to release its third‑quarter earnings after the U.S. market close on Thursday (the 29th).

items.title: 油價居高不下的代價！加拿大央行升息1碼 可能還得再升
items.title_en: The High Cost of Rising Oil Prices! Bank of Canada Raises Rates by One Quarter Point, May Need More
paras: 加拿大央行周三(28日)宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，將基準隔夜利率提高至2.5%，為2023年7月以來首次升息，符合市場預期。央行警告，中東戰事推升能源價格，可能進一步擴散至其他商品與服務，未來仍可能需要升息，但考量經濟與地緣政治的不確定性，將謹慎行事。

防堵能源成本擴散 通膨回歸目標延至2028年

加拿大央行總裁馬克林(Tiff Macklem)表示，通膨展望明顯升高，加上經濟展現韌性，有必要調高利率，降低能源價格上漲演變為全面性通膨的風險。決策委員會認為，通膨風險增加，貨幣政策維持寬鬆的空間已縮小。
加拿大9月通膨率升至3.2%，超出央行1%至3%的目標區間，主要來自能源與相關運輸成本。央行預估，通膨年底將達3.5%，明年多數時間維持約3%，直到2028年中才回到接近2%的目標。
央行同步將2027年平均通膨預測，由7月估計的2%大幅上修至3.1%。馬克林指出，過往經驗與企業調查顯示，未來一年成本轉嫁程度將提高，使能源漲價對通膨的影響更持久。
不過，決策委員會也討論過維持利率不變，理由包括物價壓力仍集中於能源、經濟尚有閒置產能，以及美加關稅爭端可能拖累成長。馬克林強調，未來將逐次會議評估政策，未承諾連續升息。

經濟展望上修 關稅與就業疲弱仍構成風險

加拿大央行將今年經濟成長預測由0.7%上修至1%，並將2027年及2028年預測，由各1.8%提高至2%。聯邦政府推動的生產力投資抵減措施與重大建設，是支撐成長的部分原因。
短期動能仍可能放緩。央行預估，經濟成長年率將從第二季的3.3%，降至第三季的2%，第四季再降至0.8%，反映美國新增關稅的衝擊。馬克林預期，2027年可望隨消費支出延續、出口回升及企業投資增強而恢復動能，逐步吸收閒置產能。
然而，加拿大就業人數已連續兩個月下滑，房市疲弱，移民減少也對部分產業形成壓力。反對升息的經濟學家認為，排除波動項目的核心通膨仍約2%，此時緊縮可能妨礙溫和復甦。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場經濟學家Andrew Grantham預期，核心通膨不會如央行擔憂般加速，政策利率應無須升破2.75%。Servus Credit Union首席經濟學家Charles St-Arnaud則認為，除非經濟轉弱或通膨低於預期，否則12月仍可能再升息。
決策公布後，加幣變動不大，約報1美元兌1.405加幣。加拿大央行下次利率決策訂於12月9日。
paras_en: The Bank of Canada announced on Wednesday (the 28th) that it is raising its policy overnight rate by one quarter point (25 basis points) to 2.5%, its first hike since July 2023 and in line with market expectations. The bank warned that the Middle‑East conflict is pushing up energy prices, which could spill over into other goods and services, and that further rate hikes may be needed, but it will act cautiously given economic and geopolitical uncertainties.

To curb the spread of higher energy costs and bring inflation back to target by 2028, Governor Tiff Macklem said that the inflation outlook has risen sharply and, combined with a resilient economy, makes a rate increase necessary to reduce the risk that rising energy prices turn into broad‑based inflation. The policy committee sees rising inflation risks and a shrinking scope for accommodative policy.

Canada’s September inflation rate rose to 3.2%, above the bank’s 1‑3% target range, driven mainly by energy and related transport costs. The bank projects inflation will reach 3.5% by year‑end and stay around 3% for most of next year, only returning to near‑2% by mid‑2028.

At the same time, the bank lifted its 2027 average inflation forecast from the July estimate of 2% to 3.1%. Macklem noted that past experience and business surveys suggest cost‑pass‑through will increase over the next year, making the impact of energy price hikes on inflation more persistent.

However, the committee also discussed keeping rates unchanged, citing that price pressures remain concentrated in energy, there is still idle capacity in the economy, and the US‑Canada tariff dispute could weigh on growth. Macklem stressed that policy will be assessed at each meeting and no commitment to consecutive hikes has been made.

The bank upgraded its economic outlook, raising this year’s growth forecast from 0.7% to 1% and lifting the 2027 and 2028 forecasts from 1.8% to 2%. Federal productivity‑investment tax credits and major infrastructure projects are cited as part of the growth support.

Short‑term momentum may still slow. The bank expects annualised growth to fall from 3.3% in Q2 to 2% in Q3 and to 0.8% in Q4, reflecting the impact of new US tariffs. Macklem expects momentum to recover in 2027 as consumer spending continues, exports rebound and business investment picks up, gradually absorbing idle capacity.

Nevertheless, Canadian employment has declined for two consecutive months, the housing market is weak, and reduced immigration is pressuring some sectors. Economists opposed to rate hikes argue that core inflation, stripped of volatile items, remains around 2%, and tightening now could hinder a modest recovery.

CIBC capital‑markets economist Andrew Grantham expects core inflation will not accelerate as the bank fears and that the policy rate need not rise above 2.75%. Servus Credit Union chief economist Charles St‑Arnaud believes another hike is still possible in December unless the economy weakens or inflation falls short of expectations.
After the decision, the Canadian dollar moved little, quoted at roughly 1 USD = 1.405 CAD. The Bank of Canada’s next rate decision is scheduled for December 9.

items.title: 溫蒂漢堡要下市了？獲14億美元收購提案 盤中股價飆近17%
items.title_en: Wendy's May Go Private? $1.4 Billion Acquisition Proposal Sends Stock Up Nearly 17%
paras: 由激進投資人佩爾茨(Nelson Peltz)旗下Trian Fund Management領軍的投資團隊，提議以約14億美元收購速食連鎖業者溫蒂漢堡(WEN-US)，並將其私有化。周三(28日)監管文件顯示，收購價為每股現金7.35美元，較周二收盤價溢價約20%，帶動溫蒂盤前股價一度大漲約16%至7.12美元。
截稿前，溫蒂漢堡(WEN-US)盤中股價上漲14.25%，每股暫報7.02美元，稍早一度漲近17%。
收購團隊包括投資公司BlueFive Capital、Sixth Street Partners及餐飲營運商Flynn Group。Flynn經營逾340家溫蒂餐廳，是其美國最大加盟商之一，也是澳洲與紐西蘭的總加盟商。Trian與關係人目前合計持有溫蒂約16.3%股權。
Trian在致溫蒂的信中表示，公司正處於「關鍵時刻」，面臨美國消費者承壓、經濟不確定性、原物料持續通膨，以及速食漢堡市場競爭加劇，需要大筆資金降低槓桿，並推動扭轉營運表現的策略。
這項提案正值溫蒂陷入經營低潮。即使計入周三漲幅，股價過去兩年仍累計下跌65%，同店銷售也已連續六季衰退。精打細算的消費者減少外食，迫使溫蒂與同業加碼折扣促銷，爭取來客。
溫蒂近年執行長頻繁更替，重整方向也隨之變動。前Potbelly執行長Bob Wright於5月接掌公司，8月首次主持財報電話會議時，直指優惠方案定位混亂、門市執行不一致，以及一次性促銷過多等問題。
佩爾茨與溫蒂的淵源可追溯至逾20年前的股東行動。Trian曾於2022年探索收購，後來作罷；今年稍早再傳籌備私有化，但隨後報導指出，該公司對溫蒂營運表現、估值及策略方向仍有疑慮，當時無意立即出價。
佩爾茨2月曾表示，溫蒂股價遭低估，並已接觸潛在融資來源，討論收購或其他重大交易。此次提案最先由《華爾街日報》披露，溫蒂尚未回應置評請求，Trian則不願在申報文件之外進一步評論。
paras_en: A investment team led by activist investor Nelson Peltz’s Trian Fund Management has proposed to acquire fast‑food chain Wendy’s (WEN-US) for about $1.4 billion and take it private. Regulatory filings on Wednesday (the 28th) show an offer of $7.35 in cash per share, roughly a 20% premium to Tuesday’s close, which spurred Wendy’s pre‑market price to jump about 16% to $7.12.
By the time of press, Wendy’s (WEN-US) was up 14.25% in‑session to $7.02 per share, after briefly climbing nearly 17% earlier in the day.

The acquiring group includes BlueFive Capital, Sixth Street Partners and restaurant operator Flynn Group. Flynn runs more than 340 Wendy’s locations, making it one of the chain’s largest U.S. franchisees and the master franchisee for Australia and New Zealand. Trian and its affiliates currently own about 16.3% of Wendy’s.

In a letter to Wendy’s, Trian said the company is at a “critical juncture,” facing pressure on U.S. consumers, economic uncertainty, ongoing raw‑material inflation and intensifying competition in the fast‑food burger market. It needs substantial capital to reduce leverage and to execute a turnaround strategy.

The proposal comes as Wendy’s is in a prolonged slump. Even after Wednesday’s rally, the stock has fallen 65% over the past two years and comparable‑store sales have declined for six consecutive quarters. Cost‑conscious diners are cutting back on eating out, forcing Wendy’s and rivals to deepen discount promotions to attract customers.

Wendy’s has seen frequent CEO changes in recent years, with its strategic direction shifting each time. Former Potbelly CEO Bob Wright took the helm in May, and in August’s first earnings call he pointed to a confusing discount‑program positioning, inconsistent store execution and an over‑reliance on one‑off promotions.

Peltz’s connection to Wendy’s goes back more than two decades of shareholder activism. Trian explored a purchase in 2022 but walked away; earlier this year rumors of a privatization resurfaced, though reports said the firm still had doubts about Wendy’s performance, valuation and strategic direction and was not ready to make an offer.

In February, Peltz said Wendy’s stock was undervalued and that he had reached out to potential financing sources to discuss an acquisition or other material transaction. The proposal was first disclosed by The Wall Street Journal; Wendy’s has not responded to comment requests, and Trian declined to comment further beyond the filing.

items.title: Fed在提醒市場別押太多？華爾街分析師對升息前景看法分歧
items.title_en: Is the Fed Warning the Market Not to Over‑bet? Wall Street Analysts Split on Rate‑Hike Outlook
paras: 聯準會(Fed)周三(28日)維持利率不變，但華爾街對決策釋出的訊號看法分歧。部分分析師認為，僅兩名官員主張升息，加上聲明強調等待更多資訊，意味市場對後續緊縮的預期可能過高；另一些人則指出，Fed將經濟成長描述由「穩健」上調為「強勁」，搭配持續偏高的通膨，仍支持12月恢復升息。
Fed本次以10票贊成、2票反對，將聯邦基金利率目標區間維持於3.75%至4%。理事庫克與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克主張升息1碼。聲明表示，累積更多資訊將有助判斷適當政策立場，以確保通膨及時回到2%目標。

等待更多數據 是偏鴿訊號還是升息前的暫停

Harris Financial Group管理合夥人Jamie Cox認為，Fed是在提醒市場，投資人預期的升息幅度可能超過央行實際準備採取的行動。他將「依賴數據」解讀為，除非情勢迫使Fed出手，否則官員暫時不想進一步調整政策。
Corpay首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta則認為，這次僅有兩票反對，少於許多人原先預期的三至四票，算是略偏鴿派的意外。不過，Fed同時上調對經濟的評價，應足以讓市場理解，後續仍可能進一步緊縮。
Annex Wealth Management首席經濟策略師Brian Jacobsen表示，理事投下反對票令人略感意外，但更值得注意的是，Fed將經濟成長描述由「穩健」改為「強勁」。他質疑，在部分就業與成長指標已降溫之際，央行為何反而提高評價。
Jacobsen指出，ADP每周就業增幅的移動平均值，在7月至9月會議之間呈上升趨勢，但此後已轉弱；亞特蘭大聯準銀行GDPNow模型顯示的成長熱度也有所下降。
他認為，這或許解釋了聲明為何採取較模糊的政策措辭。9月Fed曾表示升息是「移除部分寬鬆」，暗示利率仍偏低；本次改稱需要更多資訊來判斷，則讓目前政策是否仍過於寬鬆的答案變得不明確。

高盛估12月恢復升息 明年仍有加碼緊縮風險

高盛資產管理固定收益與流動性解決方案全球主管暨投資長Kay Haigh預期，Fed將於12月恢復升息。她指出，9月強勁的消費者物價指數(CPI)再次提醒市場，通膨上行風險仍在，央行可能透過進一步升息，為這些風險預作防範。
Haigh表示，雖然9月利率點陣圖暗示今年只會再升息一次，但若能源價格再度上揚，或後續經濟數據持續強勁，明年仍可能需要額外緊縮。
Natixis美國首席經濟學家Christopher Hodge的看法更為鮮明。他認為，通膨仍是問題，經濟成長維持穩健，失業率也大致穩定，12月升息幾乎已成定局。真正需要解釋的是，既然最終仍須行動，為何現在要延後？
Hodge指出，這次暫停符合紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯與副主席傑佛遜先前釋出的訊號，即目前沒有連續升息的急迫性。他也推測，兩次會議之間的資產價格波動與部分科技股走弱，可能已帶來一定程度的金融緊縮，讓Fed選擇多等一些數據。
他預期，主席華許可能會強調，Fed觀察的是整體趨勢，而非單一數據，但這樣的回答未必足以滿足市場對暫停理由的疑問。

油價衝擊難靠升息化解 官員面臨政策效果爭論

Motley Fool Asset Management首席投資策略師Bill Mann認為，聲明強調需要「更多資訊」，反映Fed內部可能對石油價格究竟造成多少通膨壓力，存在明顯分歧。
Mann表示，貨幣政策無法直接解決地緣政治造成的失衡。他也質疑，在當前決策中，2%通膨目標是否真的是Fed最優先考量，認為官員重申目標的表態成分較高。
這些評論凸顯華爾街的核心分歧：若通膨壓力主要來自能源與供應衝擊，等待更多資訊有其道理；但若物價壓力持續擴散，且經濟足以承受緊縮，延後升息也可能增加日後控制通膨的難度。

利率不動不等於借貸壓力解除

TransUnion全球研究與顧問主管Charlie Wise表示，Fed此次決策反映其持續權衡通膨風險，以及仍具韌性的經濟與就業情勢。即使近期通膨高於預期，官員仍選擇先評估9月升息的影響，並觀察穩定的勞動市場。
對消費者而言，暫停升息意味信用卡借貸成本暫時不會因本次政策決策而進一步提高，但利率風險並未消失。Wise提醒，隨著假期消費旺季到來，若通膨持續、利率長期居高不下，累積較大的信用卡未償餘額仍可能帶來沉重成本。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged on Wednesday (the 28th), but Wall Street was divided over the signal the decision sent. Some analysts said that only two officials favored a hike and the statement’s emphasis on waiting for more data meant the market may be over‑estimating the likelihood of further tightening; others pointed out that the Fed upgraded its view of economic growth from “steady” to “strong” and, together with still‑elevated inflation, still supports a rate increase in December.

The Fed voted 10‑2 to keep the federal‑funds target range at 3.75%‑4.00%. Board member Cook and Cleveland Fed President Harker each voted for a one‑basis‑point hike. The statement said that gathering more information will help determine the appropriate policy stance to ensure inflation returns to the 2% target in a timely manner.

Waiting for more data – a dovish signal or a pause before another hike? Jamie Cox, managing partner at Harris Financial Group, said the Fed is reminding the market that investors may be expecting larger hikes than the central bank is prepared to deliver. He reads “relying on data” as meaning that unless conditions force the Fed’s hand, officials do not want to adjust policy further for now.

Corpay chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said the two dissenting votes were fewer than the three‑to‑four many had expected, a slightly dovish surprise. However, the Fed’s upgraded economic outlook should be enough for the market to understand that further tightening remains possible.

Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management, said the dissenting votes were a mild surprise, but the more noteworthy point was the Fed’s shift in describing growth from “steady” to “strong.” He questioned why the central bank would raise its assessment when some employment and growth indicators have already cooled.

Jacobsen noted that the moving average of weekly ADP job gains rose between the July‑September meetings but has since weakened, and the Atlanta Fed’s GDPNow model also shows a slowdown in growth momentum.

He believes this may explain why the statement used more ambiguous policy language. In September the Fed said a hike would “remove some accommodation,” implying rates were still low; this time it said more information is needed to judge, leaving the question of whether policy is still too accommodative unclear.

Goldman Sachs estimates a December rate hike, with continued tightening risk next year. Kay Haigh, global head of fixed‑income and liquidity solutions at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, expects the Fed to resume hikes in December. She noted that September’s strong CPI again reminded the market that inflation‑upside risks remain, and the central bank may pre‑emptively tighten further to guard against those risks.

Haigh added that although the September rate‑dot plot suggested only one more hike this year, a resurgence in energy prices or persistently strong economic data could require additional tightening next year.

Natixis U.S. chief economist Christopher Hodge was even more blunt. He said inflation remains a problem, growth stays solid and unemployment is roughly stable, making a December hike almost a foregone conclusion. The real question, he argued, is why the Fed is delaying action now if it ultimately has to act.

Hodge pointed out that the pause aligns with signals previously given by New York Fed President Williams and Vice‑Chair Jefferson that there is no urgent need for consecutive hikes. He also speculated that asset‑price volatility and weakness in some tech stocks between the two meetings may have already introduced a degree of financial tightening, giving the Fed room to wait for more data.

He expects Chair Waller may stress that the Fed is looking at the overall trend rather than any single data point, but that answer may not fully satisfy the market’s demand for a clear rationale for the pause.

Motley Fool Asset Management chief investment strategist Bill Mann said the statement’s emphasis on “more information” reflects an internal split at the Fed over how much oil price shocks are feeding inflation.

Mann argued that monetary policy cannot directly solve the imbalances caused by geopolitical events. He also questioned whether the 2% inflation target is truly the Fed’s top priority in the current decision‑making, suggesting that officials are largely restating the target for political reasons.

These comments highlight the core Wall Street divide: if inflation pressure is mainly from energy and supply shocks, waiting for more data makes sense; but if price pressures keep spreading and the economy can absorb tightening, postponing hikes could make future inflation control harder.

Charlie Wise, head of global research and consulting at TransUnion, said the Fed’s decision reflects its ongoing weighing of inflation risks against a still‑resilient economy and labor market. Even though recent inflation has been higher than expected, officials chose to first assess the impact of the September hike and watch a stable labor market.

For consumers, a pause means credit‑card borrowing costs won’t rise immediately because of this policy move, but interest‑rate risk remains. Wise warned that as the holiday‑spending season approaches, persistent inflation and sustained high rates could make large outstanding credit‑card balances very costly.

items.title_en: The High Cost of Rising Oil Prices! Bank of Canada Raises Rates by One Quarter Point, May Need More
paras: 加拿大央行周三(28日)宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，將基準隔夜利率提高至2.5%，為2023年7月以來首次升息，符合市場預期。央行警告，中東戰事推升能源價格，可能進一步擴散至其他商品與服務，未來仍可能需要升息，但考量經濟與地緣政治的不確定性，將謹慎行事。

防堵能源成本擴散 通膨回歸目標延至2028年

加拿大央行總裁馬克林(Tiff Macklem)表示，通膨展望明顯升高，加上經濟展現韌性，有必要調高利率，降低能源價格上漲演變為全面性通膨的風險。決策委員會認為，通膨風險增加，貨幣政策維持寬鬆的空間已縮小。
加拿大9月通膨率升至3.2%，超出央行1%至3%的目標區間，主要來自能源與相關運輸成本。央行預估，通膨年底將達3.5%，明年多數時間維持約3%，直到2028年中才回到接近2%的目標。
央行同步將2027年平均通膨預測，由7月估計的2%大幅上修至3.1%。馬克林指出，過往經驗與企業調查顯示，未來一年成本轉嫁程度將提高，使能源漲價對通膨的影響更持久。
不過，決策委員會也討論過維持利率不變，理由包括物價壓力仍集中於能源、經濟尚有閒置產能，以及美加關稅爭端可能拖累成長。馬克林強調，未來將逐次會議評估政策，未承諾連續升息。

經濟展望上修 關稅與就業疲弱仍構成風險

加拿大央行將今年經濟成長預測由0.7%上修至1%，並將2027年及2028年預測，由各1.8%提高至2%。聯邦政府推動的生產力投資抵減措施與重大建設，是支撐成長的部分原因。
短期動能仍可能放緩。央行預估，經濟成長年率將從第二季的3.3%，降至第三季的2%，第四季再降至0.8%，反映美國新增關稅的衝擊。馬克林預期，2027年可望隨消費支出延續、出口回升及企業投資增強而恢復動能，逐步吸收閒置產能。
然而，加拿大就業人數已連續兩個月下滑，房市疲弱，移民減少也對部分產業形成壓力。反對升息的經濟學家認為，排除波動項目的核心通膨仍約2%，此時緊縮可能妨礙溫和復甦。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場經濟學家Andrew Grantham預期，核心通膨不會如央行擔憂般加速，政策利率應無須升破2.75%。Servus Credit Union首席經濟學家Charles St-Arnaud則認為，除非經濟轉弱或通膨低於預期，否則12月仍可能再升息。
決策公布後，加幣變動不大，約報1美元兌1.405加幣。加拿大央行下次利率決策訂於12月9日。
paras_en: The Bank of Canada announced on Wednesday (the 28th) that it is raising its policy overnight rate by one quarter point (25 basis points) to 2.5%, its first hike since July 2023 and in line with market expectations. The bank warned that the Middle‑East conflict is pushing up energy prices, which could spill over into other goods and services, and that further rate hikes may be needed, but it will act cautiously given economic and geopolitical uncertainties.

To curb the spread of higher energy costs and bring inflation back to target by 2028, Governor Tiff Macklem said that the inflation outlook has risen sharply and, combined with a resilient economy, makes a rate increase necessary to reduce the risk that rising energy prices turn into broad‑based inflation. The policy committee sees rising inflation risks and a shrinking scope for accommodative policy.

Canada’s September inflation rate rose to 3.2%, above the bank’s 1‑3% target range, driven mainly by energy and related transport costs. The bank projects inflation will reach 3.5% by year‑end and stay around 3% for most of next year, only returning to near‑2% by mid‑2028.

At the same time, the bank lifted its 2027 average inflation forecast from the July estimate of 2% to 3.1%. Macklem noted that past experience and business surveys suggest cost‑pass‑through will increase over the next year, making the impact of energy price hikes on inflation more persistent.

However, the committee also discussed keeping rates unchanged, citing that price pressures remain concentrated in energy, there is still idle capacity in the economy, and the US‑Canada tariff dispute could weigh on growth. Macklem stressed that policy will be assessed at each meeting and no commitment to consecutive hikes has been made.

The bank upgraded its economic outlook, raising this year’s growth forecast from 0.7% to 1% and lifting the 2027 and 2028 forecasts from 1.8% to 2%. Federal productivity‑investment tax credits and major infrastructure projects are cited as part of the growth support.

Short‑term momentum may still slow. The bank expects annualised growth to fall from 3.3% in Q2 to 2% in Q3 and to 0.8% in Q4, reflecting the impact of new US tariffs. Macklem expects momentum to recover in 2027 as consumer spending continues, exports rebound and business investment picks up, gradually absorbing idle capacity.

Nevertheless, Canadian employment has declined for two consecutive months, the housing market is weak, and reduced immigration is pressuring some sectors. Economists opposed to rate hikes argue that core inflation, stripped of volatile items, remains around 2%, and tightening now could hinder a modest recovery.

CIBC capital‑markets economist Andrew Grantham expects core inflation will not accelerate as the bank fears and that the policy rate need not rise above 2.75%. Servus Credit Union chief economist Charles St‑Arnaud believes another hike is still possible in December unless the economy weakens or inflation falls short of expectations.
After the decision, the Canadian dollar moved little, quoted at roughly 1 USD = 1.405 CAD. The Bank of Canada’s next rate decision is scheduled for December 9.

items.title: 紐西蘭央行意外按兵不動 維持利率於2.75% 委員會意見分歧
items.title_en: New Zealand Central Bank Unexpectedly Holds Rate at 2.75% Amid Committee Split
paras: 紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)周三(28日)出乎市場意料，決定將官方現金利率(OCR)維持在 2.75% 不變。在媒體調查的 25 位經濟學家當中，僅有 2 位預期利率將維持不動，其餘多數專家均預估央行會升息 1 碼(25 個基點)。
決策公布後，紐元兌美元一度重挫 1.7%(跌至 55.86 美分)，紐西蘭基準股指 NZX 50 下跌 0.5%，對政策敏感的 2 年期政府公債殖利率則下滑 12 個基點至 3.82%。
根據央行公布的會議紀錄，貨幣政策委員會(MPC)最終以 4 比 3 的微幅差距通過按兵不動的決議。委員Paul Conway、Hayley Gourley與Karen Silk投票支持升息 1 碼至 3.00%；然而包含總裁Anna Breman與Prasanna Gai在內的 4 位委員則選擇維持利率不變。
主張暫緩升息者指出，當前經濟復甦步調脆弱，特別是家庭消費與投資意願低迷，且全球地緣政治與經濟環境突變的風險升高，因此宜採取觀望態度。
紐西蘭央行總裁 Breman表示：「在本次會議中，我們認為符合先前溝通方針是適當的，即維持基準利率不變，並持續釋出未來幾次會議極可能進一步升息的訊號。」
針對紐元下挫對通膨的影響，Breman補充說明：「當面對通膨壓力時，我們當然樂見紐元走強，但我們必須將其與影響中長期通膨的所有其他因素綜合權衡。因此我們正在密切觀察並謹慎評估其對未來通膨的影響。」
然而，這項決策遭到市場經濟學家的強烈質疑。Bank of New Zealand研究主管Stephen Toplis表示：「坦白說，我們對紐西蘭央行維持利率不變的決定感到大吃一驚。雖然央行並無義務跟隨市場定價或共識，但如此背道而馳極為罕見。央行此舉推動本已疲軟的紐元進一步下跌，瞬間加劇了通膨壓力。」
儘管紐西蘭 9 月季度消費者物價年增率已自前季的 4.1% 放緩至 3.7%，但仍高於央行設定的 1% 至 3% 目標區間。紐西蘭央行強調，若國內物價壓力未能有效緩解，後續會議仍不排除重新採取緊縮政策。
paras_en: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) on Wednesday (the 28th) surprised markets by deciding to keep the official cash rate (OCR) unchanged at 2.75%. Of the 25 economists surveyed by the media, only two expected the rate to stay steady, while the majority forecast a one‑point (25‑basis‑point) hike.

After the decision was announced, the New Zealand dollar fell as much as 1.7% against the U.S. dollar, sliding to US$0.5586, the NZX 50 index dropped 0.5%, and the policy‑sensitive two‑year government bond yield slipped 12 basis points to 3.82%.

According to the minutes released by the bank, the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) approved the hold by a narrow 4‑to‑3 vote. Committee members Paul Conway, Hayley Gourley and Karen Silk voted for a one‑point increase to 3.00%, while four members, including Governor Anna Breman and Prasanna Gai, voted to keep the rate unchanged.

Those advocating a pause argued that the current economic recovery is fragile, especially with weak household consumption and investment appetite, and that the risk of sudden shifts in the global geopolitical and economic environment has risen, warranting a wait‑and‑see approach.

RBNZ Governor Breman said, "In this meeting we felt it was appropriate to follow our prior communication stance, namely to keep the policy rate unchanged while continuing to signal that future meetings are very likely to see further hikes."

Addressing the impact of the dollar’s decline on inflation, Breman added, "When faced with inflationary pressure we would of course welcome a stronger NZD, but we have to weigh that against all other factors affecting medium‑ to long‑term inflation. We are therefore monitoring closely and carefully assessing its effect on future inflation."

However, the decision was met with strong criticism from market economists. Stephen Toplis, research head at Bank of New Zealand, said, "Frankly, we were shocked by the RBNZ’s decision to hold rates. While the bank is not obliged to follow market pricing or consensus, such a divergence is extremely rare. The move pushes an already weak NZD even lower, instantly amplifying inflation pressures."

Even though New Zealand’s September quarterly CPI annual growth slowed from 4.1% in the prior quarter to 3.7%, it remains above the bank’s 1%‑3% target range. The RBNZ stressed that if domestic price pressures do not ease effectively, future meetings could still see a return to tightening.

items.title: 〈台幣〉央行重申柳樹理論 量縮觀望升值3.4分收在32.418元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar: Central Bank Reaffirms Willow‑Tree Theory, Reduced Volume, Cautious, Gains 3.4 cents to Close at 32.418
paras: 新台幣今(28)日量縮呈現小幅區間整理，終場收在32.418元，升值3.4分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值縮至17.03億美元。
新台幣今日以32.44元、升值1.2分開出後，一度貶至32.498元，盤中呈現升貶互見，午盤過後全面走升，最高見到32.398元，全日高低價差僅1角。
觀察主要亞幣，日元升逾0.1%，新台幣收升0.1%，人民幣處平盤左右，泰銖和星元貶0.05%左右，韓元則是重挫近1%。
中央銀行總裁楊金龍今日在立院備詢時強調，央行面對匯市一向採「柳樹理論」，讓匯率適度擺動，出現異常波動或失序時，基於維持金融穩定立場下會調節，以防波動過大。
統一投顧指出，中東外交出現轉機，油價回落，再加上 Meta 發行案獲 5 倍超額認購，帶動美股反彈，市場等待本周聯準會利率決策和CSP大廠財報，同時，台股短線負乖離大、技術指標落入超賣區，本周尚有聯發科、台達電、聯電等電子大廠法說會以及鴻海科技日等，有利於反彈。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar showed a modest range‑bound contraction today (28th), closing at 32.418 per US $, a gain of 3.4 cents, while transaction volume at a Taipei FX brokerage fell to $1.703 billion.

The dollar opened at 32.44, up 1.2 cents, then slipped to 32.498 before fluctuating intraday; after the lunch break it rallied steadily, touching a high of 32.398, with the day's high‑low spread limited to just one tenth of a unit.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Japanese yen rose more than 0.1%, the New Taiwan dollar gained 0.1%, the Chinese yuan stayed roughly flat, the Thai baht and Singapore dollar each fell about 0.05%, while the Korean won plunged nearly 1%.

Central Bank Governor Yang Jin‑long emphasized in a legislative hearing that the bank always applies the “willow‑tree theory” to allow exchange rates to move moderately, and will intervene to maintain financial stability if abnormal or disorderly swings occur.

Unified Investment Research noted that a diplomatic breakthrough in the Middle East and a pull‑back in oil prices, combined with Meta’s offering being oversubscribed five‑fold, sparked a rebound in US equities. Markets await this week’s Fed rate decision and major CSP earnings; meanwhile, Taiwan’s market shows a short‑term negative divergence and technical indicators in oversold territory, but upcoming earnings calls from MediaTek, Delta Electronics, UMC and Foxconn’s Tech Day could support a bounce.

items.title: 最穩貨幣變「科技籌碼」？AI正改變美元避險邏輯　專家：一旦交易逆轉  外資撤離恐成新風險
items.title_en: Is the Safest Currency Turning into a "Tech Bet"? AI Is Changing the Dollar's Hedge Logic – Expert Warns That a Trade Reversal Could Trigger Capital Outflows as a New Risk
paras: 美元長期被視為全球動盪時的首選避風港，但隨著海外資金大舉湧入美國AI概念股、公司債與電力基礎設施，這項「避險屬性」正被重新定價，美元也越來越像一檔綁定科技敘事的「高貝他資產」。對此專家最新指出，一旦AI交易邏輯動搖，美元未必再從恐慌中受惠，反而可能面臨資金撤離的雙重打擊。
野村證券G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning直言，若AI交易出現逆轉，「美元能否像過去那樣受益，已沒那麼確定」。上周市場已見初步痕跡，AI資產估值承壓時，避險資金轉向日元與瑞郎，而非美元，美元兌歐元小幅升值，主要反映法國社會動盪拖累歐元，而非避險買盤進場。
Convera首席外匯與宏觀策略師Kevin Ford指出，當AI交易被放在放大鏡下檢視，其與美元走勢的連動反而更清晰。外資流入美股規模已創下歷史紀錄，但外國直接投資(FDI)成長落後，意味著增量資金多來自法人機構的可移動倉位，本質上接近新興市場常見的「熱錢」。
富國銀行Erik Nelson將其比作新興市場資本流動，並稱AI熱潮強化了「美國成長更快、通膨更黏、利率更高」的預期，推升美元與美債殖利率同步走強。
此外，支撐邏輯也是風險源頭。若AI投報率不及預期，拋售可能同時蔓延至股票、投資級信貸與利率市場，成長放緩迫使Fed降息、削弱收益優勢，資本開支減速動搖「美國例外論」，機構降低美股與企業債配置，則直接抽走美元流入底座。
相較於2000年網路泡沫時期，當前脆弱性更集中。目前，外資更集中押注美股與公司債，直接投資偏弱。按貿易加權實質匯率，美元已經連12年高於長期均值，創1973年來最長紀錄。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場(CIBC)FICC策略總監Noah Buffam說，AI交易推動利率預期重定價，是這波美元漲勢的核心驅動。
高負債雲端運算商CoreWeave等企業的信用違約交換(CDS)利差近周大幅擴張，加拿大豐業銀行(Scotiabank)首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，信貸市場正釋出風險由表層滲出的訊號。若基設報酬落空，信用利差走闊、削減資本開支，衝擊將外溢至硬體、工業設備與能源需求。
此外，美國政府財政空間也比2000年更窄。當年接近預算盈餘，現在則是巨額赤字，逆周期刺激餘地有限。判斷美元是否轉弱，關鍵不在科技股單日大跌，而在信貸與增長壓力是否改變Fed路徑，但若是成真，日元將率先受惠。
不過美元崩跌並非必然。若拋售嚴重到引發全球美元融資搶籌，2008與2020年式的「流動性逼升」仍可能短線推高美元，只是難以持續。
Nelson也提醒，全球投資人對美元重定價的敏感度極高，展望2027年，這道被AI綁住的避險裂縫，值得持續盯防。
paras_en: The dollar has long been seen as the go‑to safe haven during global turmoil, but as overseas capital pours into U.S. AI‑related stocks, corporate bonds and power infrastructure, this "hedge attribute" is being re‑priced, making the dollar increasingly resemble a high‑beta asset tied to a tech narrative. Experts now warn that if AI‑driven trading logic wavers, the dollar may no longer benefit from panic and could instead face a double hit from capital withdrawals.

Nomura’s G10 FX strategy head Dominic Bunning bluntly said that if AI‑driven trading reverses, “it’s no longer certain the dollar will benefit as it has in the past.” Last week the market showed early signs: as AI asset valuations came under pressure, safe‑haven flows shifted to the yen and the franc rather than the dollar, while the dollar‑euro pair edged higher mainly because French social unrest weighed on the euro, not because of hedge buying.

Convera’s chief FX and macro strategist Kevin Ford noted that when AI trading is examined under a microscope, its correlation with the dollar becomes even clearer. Foreign inflows into U.S. equities have hit historic highs, but foreign direct investment (FDI) growth lags, meaning the incremental money largely comes from institutional “portable” positions – essentially the same hot‑money flows typical of emerging markets.

Wells Fargo’s Erik Nelson likened the situation to emerging‑market capital flows, saying the AI boom reinforces expectations of “faster U.S. growth, stickier inflation and higher rates,” which pushes the dollar and U.S. Treasury yields higher together.

Moreover, the supporting logic is itself a source of risk. If AI returns fall short of expectations, sell‑offs could spill over to equities, investment‑grade credit and the rate markets; slower growth would force the Fed to cut rates, eroding the yield advantage, while a slowdown in capex would undermine the “U.S. exception” thesis, prompting institutions to trim U.S. equity and corporate‑bond allocations and directly pull the dollar’s inflow base.

Compared with the 2000‑dot‑com bubble, today’s vulnerabilities are more concentrated. Foreign capital is now more focused on U.S. equities and corporate bonds, with direct investment weaker. On a trade‑weighted real exchange‑rate basis, the dollar has been above its long‑term average for 12 consecutive years, the longest stretch since 1973.
CIBC’s FICC strategy head Noah Buffam said AI‑driven trading is reshaping rate expectations, which is the core driver of the current dollar rally.

Credit‑default‑swap spreads on highly leveraged cloud‑computing firms such as CoreWeave have widened sharply in recent weeks. Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne warned that the credit market is sending early warning signals from the surface. If underlying AI returns disappoint, widening credit spreads and reduced capex will spill over to hardware, industrial equipment and energy demand.

In addition, the U.S. fiscal space is tighter than in 2000. Back then the budget was near surplus; today it runs a massive deficit, leaving little room for counter‑cyclical stimulus. Whether the dollar weakens hinges less on a single day’s tech‑stock plunge and more on whether credit and growth pressures alter the Fed’s policy path – and if that happens, the yen would be the first beneficiary.

Nevertheless, a dollar collapse is not inevitable. If sell‑offs become severe enough to trigger a global scramble for dollar funding, a liquidity‑driven surge akin to 2008 or 2020 could temporarily push the dollar higher, though such a rally would be hard to sustain.

Nelson also cautioned that global investors are extremely sensitive to any re‑pricing of the dollar. Looking ahead to 2027, the AI‑tied hedge crack in the dollar’s safe‑haven status deserves close monitoring.

items.title: 〈楊金龍立院備詢〉重申匯市依循「柳樹理論」可防範波動過大
items.title_en: Yang Jinlong Reiterates That Following the “Willow Tree Theory” in the FX Market Can Prevent Excessive Volatility
paras: 中央銀行總裁楊金龍今(28)日赴立院財委會備詢，立委提及台股交投集中於特定產業，外資調節高科技股的水位就會造成新台幣的貶值壓力。對此，楊金龍回應，央行依循「柳樹理論」讓匯率適度擺動，不會睡不安穩，並再次強調沒有楊金龍防線。
楊金龍說，儘管近期因外資大幅匯出有使新台幣大幅波動，但仍睡得很安穩，畢竟匯率主要還是由供需決定，而外資在股市賺錢自然會獲利了結並匯出。
楊金龍強調，央行面對匯市一向採「柳樹理論」，讓匯率適度擺動，出現異常波動或失序時，在基於維持金融穩定立場下才會調節，以防波動過大。
楊金龍也指出，高科技業是台灣更具比較利益的產業，也是我們台灣最值得去發展的方向。
此外，楊金龍再度表示，市場資金需求相當旺盛，而我國擁有龐大的超額儲蓄，資金池充裕。
paras_en: On October 28, Central Bank Governor Yang Jinlong appeared before the Legislative Yuan’s Finance Committee. Legislators noted that trading in Taiwan’s stock market is concentrated in certain sectors, and that foreign investors adjusting the level of high‑tech stocks could create depreciation pressure on the New Taiwan dollar. In response, Yang said the central bank follows the “Willow Tree Theory” to allow the exchange rate to move moderately, ensuring stability, and he again emphasized that there is no “Yang Jinlong defense line.”

Yang explained that although recent large outflows by foreign investors have caused the New Taiwan dollar to swing sharply, the currency remains stable because exchange rates are fundamentally driven by supply and demand, and foreign investors naturally realize profits in the stock market and repatriate the proceeds.

Yang stressed that the central bank has always applied the “Willow Tree Theory” to the foreign‑exchange market, permitting moderate fluctuations. Only when abnormal or disorderly swings occur, and in order to maintain financial stability, will the bank intervene to curb excessive volatility.
Yang also pointed out that the high‑tech sector is Taiwan’s comparative advantage and the most worthwhile direction for the country’s development.
Furthermore, Yang reiterated that market demand for capital is very strong, and Taiwan enjoys a large surplus of savings, providing a plentiful pool of funds.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】FOMC會議前，美元保持強勢
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Dollar Remains Strong Ahead of the FOMC Meeting

paras: 美元周二(27日)小幅走升，市場正為一系列央行會議進行部位布局，投資人等待聯準會(Fed)等各國央行釋出新線索，以判斷經濟前景及利率走向。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.31%，報102。
上週漲勢強勁的AI概念股遭到拋售，美元隨之承壓，如今則已趨於穩定。
Convera外匯與宏觀經濟策略師Kevin Ford表示，「聯準會會議前，美元已經反彈，上週之後，市場對AI的情緒也稍微穩定了一些。」
他指出，「上週股市動盪、高油價，以及法國財政壓力引發的歐洲財政問題，都讓美元受到波及。因此，我認為市場目前的反應，是稍微減輕聯準會升息所面臨的壓力。」
聯準會預計週三公布最新政策決議，歐洲央行(ECB)將於週四公布決策，日本銀行(BoJ)則在週五為本週的央行會議畫下句點。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，因此，焦點將落在政策制定者對未來展望釋出的任何訊號。
由Mark Cabana領銜的美銀分析師在一份給投資人的報告中表示，「若聯準會維持利率不變，美元面臨的風險偏向下行：偏鷹派的訊息大致上不會帶來太大影響，但若以偏鴿派的態度維持利率不變，美元可能面臨幅度更大的跌勢。」
歐元可能成為10月表現最差的已開發市場貨幣，兌美元本月下跌1.70%，受到高能源成本、法國政府公債市場波動，以及市場對法國財政狀況的擔憂拖累。
歐洲央行公布季度銀行放款調查後，歐元跌勢略為擴大。調查顯示，央行先前升息的影響已逐漸顯現。如果這項趨勢持續，可能在一定程度上減輕歐洲央行在明年深入推進升息的壓力。
另一方面，日本財務大臣片山皋月(Satsuki Katayama)表示，政府已準備好在外匯市場採取果斷行動，再次提醒市場，日本政府仍願意出手支撐日元。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Tuesday (the 27th), as markets position themselves ahead of a series of central bank meetings, with investors awaiting new clues from the Fed and other central banks to gauge economic outlook and rate trajectories.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.31% to 102.
AI‑related stocks that surged last week were sold off, putting pressure on the dollar, which has now stabilized.
The euro rose 0.27% against the dollar, trading at 102.29.

Convera foreign‑exchange and macro‑economics strategist Kevin Ford said, "Ahead of the Fed meeting, the dollar has already bounced back, and after last week the market sentiment on AI has also calmed somewhat."

He added, "Last week’s stock market turbulence, high oil prices, and fiscal pressures in France that sparked European fiscal concerns all impacted the dollar. Therefore, I think the market’s current reaction is to slightly ease the pressure on the Fed’s rate‑hiking path."

The Fed is expected to announce its latest policy decision on Wednesday, the European Central Bank (ECB) will release its decision on Thursday, and the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will wrap up the week’s central‑bank meetings on Friday. Markets expect all three to hold rates steady, so focus will shift to any signals policymakers give about future outlooks.

Bank of America analysts led by Mark Cabana wrote in a client note, "If the Fed holds rates steady, the dollar faces a downside risk: a hawkish tone is unlikely to move markets much, but a dovish stance while holding rates could lead to a larger dollar decline."

The euro could become the worst‑performing developed‑market currency in October, having fallen 1.70% against the dollar this month, weighed down by high energy costs, volatility in France’s sovereign bond market, and concerns over French fiscal health.

After the ECB released its quarterly bank‑lending survey, the euro’s decline widened slightly. The survey showed the impact of the ECB’s earlier rate hikes is beginning to show. If this trend continues, it could somewhat relieve pressure on the ECB to push rates higher next year.

On the other hand, Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said the government is ready to take decisive action in the foreign‑exchange market, reiterating that Japan remains willing to support the yen.

The yen was one of the best‑performing major currencies last week, appreciating about 0.75% against the dollar for its biggest weekly gain since early September. At that time, rising AI‑related concerns in equities drove a strong flow into the yen.
The dollar rose 0.24% against the yen, to 157.90 yen.
The pound fell 0.19% against the dollar, to $1.3317.
The Reserve Bank of New Zealand and the Bank of Canada will also announce policy decisions on Wednesday, with markets expecting both to raise rates.
The New Zealand dollar rose 0.08% against the dollar, to $0.569.
The Canadian dollar fell 0.27% against the dollar, with the USD/CAD at 1.405 Canadian dollars.

paras: 新台幣今(27)日升貶互見，午盤過後爆量偏強反彈，終場兌一美元以32.452元作收，升值5.6分，台北外匯經紀公司再度擴大至27.33億美元；中央銀行在今日下午最新出爐的書面報告中提到，今年以來至10月21日外資淨匯出達776億美元，而聯準會年底前可能再升息1碼。
新台幣今日以32.53元、貶值2.2分開出後，一度貶至32.604元，午盤過後則扭轉弱勢，轉為成交爆量彈升，光是下午盤成交量就高達16.06億美元，最高來到32.452元，全日高低價差1.52角。
觀察主要亞幣，漲跌互見，日元逆勢走貶超過0.2%，韓元、新元和泰銖均貶約0.05%，反觀新台幣收升0.17%，美元指數則反彈近0.2%。
央行總裁楊金龍在今日出爐的業務報告也提到，上半年新台幣對美元貶值1.25%，主要是因國內匯市出現美元超額需求，外資淨匯出233億美元，使央行累計淨賣匯170.4億美元(約當GDP的-1.62%)，以維持國內匯市穩定。
而下半年以來，地緣政治風險導致美元避險需求升溫，加上聯準會9月升息1碼，使外資繼續淨匯出543億美元，新台幣貶值2%；累計今年以來新台幣貶值3.25%，外資淨匯出776億美元。
央行認為，聯準會年底前可能再升息1碼，支撐國際美元走勢，新台幣對美元匯率貶值。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar showed mixed movement today (27th), but after the midday session it rebounded strongly on heavy volume, closing at NT$32.452 per US$1, a gain of 5.6 ¢. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers expanded their net buying to US$27.33 billion; the central bank’s latest written report this afternoon noted that net foreign‑capital outflows have reached US$77.6 billion up to October 21, and the Federal Reserve may raise rates by another 0.25 percentage point before year‑end.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$32.53, down 2.2 ¢, and fell to as low as NT$32.604. After the midday session it reversed the weakness, snapping up on a volume surge – the afternoon session alone saw US$16.06 billion traded, pushing the rate up to a high of NT$32.452. The intraday range was 1.52 ¢.

Among the major Asian currencies, movements were mixed: the Japanese yen fell more than 0.2% against the dollar, while the Korean won, Singapore dollar and Thai baht each slipped about 0.05%. In contrast, the New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.17%, and the US dollar index rebounded roughly 0.2%.

Central Bank Governor Yang Jin‑long noted in today’s business report that the New Taiwan dollar depreciated 1.25% against the US dollar in the first half of the year, mainly due to excess domestic demand for dollars. Net foreign outflows of US$23.3 billion forced the bank to sell a cumulative US$17.04 billion of foreign exchange (about –1.62% of GDP) to keep the local FX market stable.

In the second half of the year, heightened geopolitical risk boosted safe‑haven demand for the dollar, and the Fed’s 0.25 percentage‑point rate hike in September prompted foreign investors to net outflow another US$54.3 billion, pushing the New Taiwan dollar down another 2%. Overall, the New Taiwan dollar has weakened 3.25% year‑to‑date, with total foreign outflows reaching US$77.6 billion.

The central bank believes the Fed may raise rates by another 0.25 percentage point before the end of the year, supporting the international dollar’s strength and keeping the New Taiwan dollar’s exchange rate on a depreciation trend.
